`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S4] How much can I claim under books and learning reimbursement?
Q: How much can I claim under books and learning reimbursement?
A: The limit for books and learning reimbursement is INR 5,000 per year.

[S5] Accommodation Norms
# Hotel & Accommodation Norms

## City-wise Caps
Metro cities: INR 8,000 per night. Tier-1 cities: INR 6,000 per night. Other cities:
INR 4,500 per night. Caps include taxes.

## Booking Preference
Accommodation must be booked through the approved corporate travel platform. Direct
bookings are reimbursed only with prior approval and valid justification.

## Shared Stay
Employees travelling together may share rooms for internal meetings. Room-sharing norms
apply only with mutual consent and are never mandatory.

## Invoice Requirements
Submit a GST invoice in the employee's name along with the stay dates. Payments to
unregistered properties are not reimbursable.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-H-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S4] How much can I claim under books and learning reimbursement?
Q: How much can I claim under books and learning reimbursement?
A: The limit for books and learning reimbursement is INR 5,000 per year.

[S5] Accommodation Norms
# Hotel & Accommodation Norms

## City-wise Caps
Metro cities: INR 8,000 per night. Tier-1 cities: INR 6,000 per night. Other cities:
INR 4,500 per night. Caps include taxes.

## Booking Preference
Accommodation must be booked through the approved corporate travel platform. Direct
bookings are reimbursed only with prior approval and valid justification.

## Shared Stay
Employees travelling together may share rooms for internal meetings. Room-sharing norms
apply only with mutual consent and are never mandatory.

## Invoice Requirements
Submit a GST invoice in the employee's name along with the stay dates. Payments to
unregistered properties are not reimbursable.

# Certification Reimbursement Policy

Reimbursement applies to certifications on the approved list published annually, such as
CAIIB, CFA, FRM, cloud certifications and role-specific technical certifications.

## Reimbursement Amount
Up to 100 percent of exam fees for certifications on the approved list, capped per grade.
Renewal and membership fees are reimbursed for active certifications.

## Conditions
- Certification must be passed, not merely attempted.
- Employee must be in service on the date of the claim.
- Reimbursement is paid against the fee receipt only.

## Bond
For certifications above the cap threshold, a service commitment of 12 months applies.
Early exit triggers pro-rata recovery.

## Approved List
Reimbursement applies to certifications on the approved list published annually, such as
CAIIB, CFA, FRM, cloud certifications and role-specific technical certifications.

## Reimbursement Amount
Up to 100 percent of exam fees for certifications on the approved list, capped per grade.

[S1] What is the eligibility for gratuity?

[S2] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S3] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] Salary Advance Policy
# Salary Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Salary advance is available for genuine emergencies after six months of service. Maximum
advance is one month's net salary.

## Repayment
The advance is recovered over three payrolls by default, or a shorter period agreed in
writing. Recovery cannot reduce take-home below statutory minimums.

## Approval
Advances require reporting-manager and HRBP approval. A second advance is not sanctioned
while a previous one is outstanding.

## Documentation
Supporting documentation of the emergency is required for advances above 50 percent of
net salary.

Policy code: HR-PAY-A-2026-01 | Owner: Payroll team.

[S5] Variable Pay Policy
# Variable Pay Policy

## Eligibility
Variable pay applies to grades M3 and above. It is paid annually against business, unit
and individual scorecard achievement.

## Payout Formula
Payout = target variable × business multiplier × unit multiplier × individual multiplier.
Multipliers range from 0 to 1.5 as per the approved scorecard.

## Timing
Variable pay for a financial year is paid in June of the following year. Employees who
resign before the payout date are not eligible unless the separation policy states otherwise.

## Disputes
Scorecard disputes must be raised within 30 days of scorecard communication to the
business review committee.

Policy code: HR-COMP-V-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards team.

# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity

five-year minimum service condition.

year of service.

[S3] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] Salary Advance Policy
# Salary Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Salary advance is available for genuine emergencies after six months of service. Maximum
advance is one month's net salary.

## Repayment
The advance is recovered over three payrolls by default, or a shorter period agreed in
writing. Recovery cannot reduce take-home below statutory minimums.

## Approval
Advances require reporting-manager and HRBP approval. A second advance is not sanctioned
while a previous one is outstanding.

## Documentation
Supporting documentation of the emergency is required for advances above 50 percent of
net salary.

Policy code: HR-PAY-A-2026-01 | Owner: Payroll team.

[S5] Variable Pay Policy
# Variable Pay Policy

## Eligibility
Variable pay applies to grades M3 and above. It is paid annually against business, unit
and individual scorecard achievement.

## Payout Formula
Payout = target variable × business multiplier × unit multiplier × individual multiplier.
Multipliers range from 0 to 1.5 as per the approved scorecard.

## Timing
Variable pay for a financial year is paid in June of the following year. Employees who
resign before the payout date are not eligible unless the separation policy states otherwise.

## Disputes
Scorecard disputes must be raised within 30 days of scorecard communication to the
business review committee.

Policy code: HR-COMP-V-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards team.

# Employee Referral Programme

## Eligibility
All permanent employees except HR recruiters and the hiring manager for the specific role
may refer candidates. Referrals must be registered in the referral portal before application.

## Reward Structure
Referral rewards are paid in two instalments: 50 percent on joining and 50 percent after
the referred employee completes six months. Senior and niche roles carry higher rewards as
published in the quarterly referral bulletin.

## Clawback
Rewards are clawed back if the referred employee exits within six months or if the referral
is found to violate the anti-nepotism policy.

## Referral Process
1. Register the candidate in the referral portal.
2. Candidate is tagged to the employee for 180 days.
3. On selection, the referral bonus is processed automatically.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] What is the re-hiring policy?
Q: What is the re-hiring policy?
A: Ex-employees who resigned in good standing may be considered for re-hiring after a cooling period of 12 months. Approval requires HRBP, business head and CHRO sign-off. Prior tenure is counted only for gratuity and long-service awards.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

# Sabbatical Policy

## Purpose
Sabbaticals support long-term personal priorities: higher education, caregiving or
extended travel.

## Eligibility
Employees with five years of continuous service and a consistent "Meets Expectations"
record may apply. Duration is 3 to 12 months.

## Terms
Sabbaticals are unpaid. Group insurance continues during the sabbatical. Seniority and
leave accrual continue but no salary is paid.

## Application and Approval
Applications require a six-month notice, manager endorsement, HRBP approval and business
head sign-off. Approval is discretionary, not an entitlement.

## Rejoining
Employees rejoin at the same grade in an available role. The bank does not guarantee the
same role or team.

Policy code: HR-SAB-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Management team.

[S5] Employee Referral Program
# Employee Referral Programme

## Eligibility
All permanent employees except HR recruiters and the hiring manager for the specific role
may refer candidates. Referrals must be registered in the referral portal before application.

## Reward Structure
Referral rewards are paid in two instalments: 50 percent on joining and 50 percent after
the referred employee completes six months. Senior and niche roles carry higher rewards as
published in the quarterly referral bulletin.

## Clawback
Rewards are clawed back if the referred employee exits within six months or if the referral
is found to violate the anti-nepotism policy.

## Referral Process
1. Register the candidate in the referral portal.
2. Candidate is tagged to the employee for 180 days.
3. On selection, the referral bonus is processed automatically.

Policy code: HR-REF-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

USER QUESTION:
What cooling period applies before a form employee can be re-hired?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] What is the re-hiring policy?
Q: What is the re-hiring policy?
A: Ex-employees who resigned in good standing may be considered for re-hiring after a cooling period of 12 months. Approval requires HRBP, business head and CHRO sign-off. Prior tenure is counted only for gratuity and long-service awards.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S4] Payroll Calendar
# Payroll Calendar

## Payroll Date
Salary is credited on the last working day of each month. If that day is a holiday, credit
happens on the previous working day.

## Input Cut-off
All inputs — attendance, leaves, reimbursements, tax declarations — must be submitted by
the 20th of the month. Inputs after the cut-off are processed in the next cycle.

## Payslip
Payslips are published on the HR self-service portal by the 1st of the following month.
Employees can download payslips for the last five years.

## Payroll Corrections
Errors must be reported within 10 days of credit. Approved corrections are adjusted in
the next payroll cycle.

Policy code: HR-PAY-2026-01 | Owner: Payroll team.

[S5] Background Verification
# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

USER QUESTION:
Who must sign off every re-hire?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] What is the re-hiring policy?
Q: What is the re-hiring policy?
A: Ex-employees who resigned in good standing may be considered for re-hiring after a cooling period of 12 months. Approval requires HRBP, business head and CHRO sign-off. Prior tenure is counted only for gratuity and long-service awards.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S3] Who can apply for job rotation?
Q: Who can apply for job rotation?
A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

[S4] Sabbatical Policy
# Sabbatical Policy

## Purpose
Sabbaticals support long-term personal priorities: higher education, caregiving or
extended travel.

## Eligibility
Employees with five years of continuous service and a consistent "Meets Expectations"
record may apply. Duration is 3 to 12 months.

## Terms
Sabbaticals are unpaid. Group insurance continues during the sabbatical. Seniority and
leave accrual continue but no salary is paid.

## Application and Approval
Applications require a six-month notice, manager endorsement, HRBP approval and business
head sign-off. Approval is discretionary, not an entitlement.

## Rejoining
Employees rejoin at the same grade in an available role. The bank does not guarantee the
same role or team.

Policy code: HR-SAB-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Management team.

[S5] Background Verification
# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: What cooling period applies before a former employee can be re-hired?
ASSISTANT: A cooling period of at least 12 months must elapse since the exit date.

Compose the final answer now.

[S4] Sabbatical Policy
# Sabbatical Policy

## Purpose
Sabbaticals support long-term personal priorities: higher education, caregiving or
extended travel.

## Eligibility
Employees with five years of continuous service and a consistent "Meets Expectations"
record may apply. Duration is 3 to 12 months.

## Terms
Sabbaticals are unpaid. Group insurance continues during the sabbatical. Seniority and
leave accrual continue but no salary is paid.

## Application and Approval
Applications require a six-month notice, manager endorsement, HRBP approval and business
head sign-off. Approval is discretionary, not an entitlement.

## Rejoining
Employees rejoin at the same grade in an available role. The bank does not guarantee the
same role or team.

Policy code: HR-SAB-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Management team.

[S5] Background Verification
# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

USER QUESTION:
Please clarify: what cooling period applies before a form employee can be re-hired?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] What is the re-hiring policy?
Q: What is the re-hiring policy?
A: Ex-employees who resigned in good standing may be considered for re-hiring after a cooling period of 12 months. Approval requires HRBP, business head and CHRO sign-off. Prior tenure is counted only for gratuity and long-service awards.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

## In One Line

up to 2 WFH days per week.

## Where to Find

[S4] Payroll Calendar
# Payroll Calendar

## Payroll Date
Salary is credited on the last working day of each month. If that day is a holiday, credit
happens on the previous working day.

## Input Cut-off
All inputs — attendance, leaves, reimbursements, tax declarations — must be submitted by
the 20th of the month. Inputs after the cut-off are processed in the next cycle.

## Payslip
Payslips are published on the HR self-service portal by the 1st of the following month.
Employees can download payslips for the last five years.

## Payroll Corrections
Errors must be reported within 10 days of credit. Approved corrections are adjusted in
the next payroll cycle.

Policy code: HR-PAY-2026-01 | Owner: Payroll team.

[S5] Leave Policy 2026
# Leave Policy — 2026

## Applicability
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Axis Bank across corporate offices,
branches and contact centres. Contractual and third-party staff are governed by the
terms of their engagement contracts.

## Types of Leave

### Privileged Leave (PL)
- 24 working days per calendar year, credited quarterly (6 per quarter).
- Can be availed up to 3 times a year.
- Minimum block of 3 continuous days per instance.
- Requests must be raised on the HR self-service portal at least 7 working days in
  advance for domestic travel and 14 working days for international travel.
- Unused PL carries forward up to a cap of 60 days.

### Casual Leave (CL)
- 8 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Cannot be carried forward.
- Maximum block of 2 continuous days.
- Requires reporting manager approval; can be applied on the same day for genuine
  emergencies.

### Sick Leave (SL)
- 12 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Medical certificate mandatory for any block of 3 or more continuous days.
- Cannot be carried forward.

### Maternity Leave
- 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children.
- 12 weeks of paid leave from the third child onwards.
- Adoption leave of 12 weeks for children below 3 months of age.
- Requests must be raised at least 8 weeks before the expected date, with the
  medical certificate attached.

### Paternity Leave
- 10 working days of paid leave available within 90 days of the child's birth.
- Can be split into 2 blocks.

### Bereavement Leave
- 5 working days for immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling).
- 2 working days for extended family.

## Compensatory Off
- Employees working on declared holidays are eligible for compensatory off within 45 days.
- Compensatory off cannot be encashed.

## Encashment
- On separation, up to 60 days of PL balance is encashed at basic + DA.
- CL and SL are not encashable.

## Escalation
For any dispute regarding leave balance, raise a ticket on HResponse under
`HR > Leave Balance`. First-level SLA is 2 business days.

# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

- Can be split into 2 blocks.

### Bereavement Leave
- 5 working days for immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling).
- 2 working days for extended family.

## Compensatory Off
- Employees working on declared holidays are eligible for compensatory off within 45 days.
- Compensatory off cannot be encashed.

## Encashment
- On separation, up to 60 days of PL balance is encashed at basic + DA.
- CL and SL are not encashable.

## Escalation

# Sabbatical Policy

## Purpose
Sabbaticals support long-term personal priorities: higher education, caregiving or
extended travel.

## Eligibility
Employees with five years of continuous service and a consistent "Meets Expectations"
record may apply. Duration is 3 to 12 months.

## Terms
Sabbaticals are unpaid. Group insurance continues during the sabbatical. Seniority and
leave accrual continue but no salary is paid.

## Application and Approval
Applications require a six-month notice, manager endorsement, HRBP approval and business
head sign-off. Approval is discretionary, not an entitlement.

same role or team.

# Employee Referral Programme

## Eligibility
All permanent employees except HR recruiters and the hiring manager for the specific role
may refer candidates. Referrals must be registered in the referral portal before application.

## Reward Structure
Referral rewards are paid in two instalments: 50 percent on joining and 50 percent after
the referred employee completes six months. Senior and niche roles carry higher rewards as
published in the quarterly referral bulletin.

## Clawback
Rewards are clawed back if the referred employee exits within six months or if the referral
is found to violate the anti-nepotism policy.

## Referral Process
1. Register the candidate in the referral portal.
2. Candidate is tagged to the employee for 180 days.
3. On selection, the referral bonus is processed automatically.

Policy code: HR-REF-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

# Leave Policy — 2026

## Applicability
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Axis Bank across corporate offices,
branches and contact centres. Contractual and third-party staff are governed by the
terms of their engagement contracts.

## Types of Leave

### Privileged Leave (PL)
- 24 working days per calendar year, credited quarterly (6 per quarter).
- Can be availed up to 3 times a year.
- Minimum block of 3 continuous days per instance.
- Requests must be raised on the HR self-service portal at least 7 working days in
  advance for domestic travel and 14 working days for international travel.
- Unused PL carries forward up to a cap of 60 days.

### Casual Leave (CL)
- 8 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Cannot be carried forward.
- Maximum block of 2 continuous days.
- Requires reporting manager approval; can be applied on the same day for genuine
  emergencies.

### Sick Leave (SL)
- 12 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Medical certificate mandatory for any block of 3 or more continuous days.
- Cannot be carried forward.

### Maternity Leave
- 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children.
- 12 weeks of paid leave from the third child onwards.
- Adoption leave of 12 weeks for children below 3 months of age.
- Requests must be raised at least 8 weeks before the expected date, with the
  medical certificate attached.

### Paternity Leave
- 10 working days of paid leave available within 90 days of the child's birth.
- Can be split into 2 blocks.

### Bereavement Leave
- 5 working days for immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling).
- 2 working days for extended family.

[S1] What is the re-hiring policy?
Q: What is the re-hiring policy?
A: Ex-employees who resigned in good standing may be considered for re-hiring after a cooling period of 12 months. Approval requires HRBP, business head and CHRO sign-off. Prior tenure is counted only for gratuity and long-service awards.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S3] Who can apply for job rotation?
Q: Who can apply for job rotation?
A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

[S4] Sabbatical Policy
# Sabbatical Policy

## Purpose
Sabbaticals support long-term personal priorities: higher education, caregiving or
extended travel.

## Eligibility
Employees with five years of continuous service and a consistent "Meets Expectations"
record may apply. Duration is 3 to 12 months.

## Terms
Sabbaticals are unpaid. Group insurance continues during the sabbatical. Seniority and
leave accrual continue but no salary is paid.

## Application and Approval
Applications require a six-month notice, manager endorsement, HRBP approval and business
head sign-off. Approval is discretionary, not an entitlement.

## Rejoining
Employees rejoin at the same grade in an available role. The bank does not guarantee the
same role or team.

Policy code: HR-SAB-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Management team.

# Wholesale Banking Leave Planning Guide 2026

## Purpose

This guide helps Wholesale Banking teams plan leave without compromising coverage during peak periods such as deal-closure cycles.

## Planning Rules

Privileged leave needs at least 7 working days of notice and manager approval.

At least 70 percent of the team must be available during declared peak windows.

Backfill plans must be agreed before overlapping leave is approved.

## Seasonal Guidance

Anticipate demand around deal-closure cycles and open early leave planning.

Rotate preferred holiday weeks across the team from year to year.

## Manager Duties

Publish the unit leave calendar quarterly.

Review pending balances and prompt planned usage.

Escalate conflicts to the HR business partner.

## Policy code

HR-LVG-WS-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations.

USER QUESTION:
Could you confirm: what cooling period applies before a form employee can be re-hired?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] What is the re-hiring policy?
Q: What is the re-hiring policy?
A: Ex-employees who resigned in good standing may be considered for re-hiring after a cooling period of 12 months. Approval requires HRBP, business head and CHRO sign-off. Prior tenure is counted only for gratuity and long-service awards.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S4] Payroll Calendar
# Payroll Calendar

## Payroll Date
Salary is credited on the last working day of each month. If that day is a holiday, credit
happens on the previous working day.

## Input Cut-off
All inputs — attendance, leaves, reimbursements, tax declarations — must be submitted by
the 20th of the month. Inputs after the cut-off are processed in the next cycle.

## Payslip
Payslips are published on the HR self-service portal by the 1st of the following month.
Employees can download payslips for the last five years.

## Payroll Corrections
Errors must be reported within 10 days of credit. Approved corrections are adjusted in
the next payroll cycle.

Policy code: HR-PAY-2026-01 | Owner: Payroll team.

[S5] Background Verification
# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

[S5] Sabbatical Policy
# Sabbatical Policy

## Purpose
Sabbaticals support long-term personal priorities: higher education, caregiving or
extended travel.

## Eligibility
Employees with five years of continuous service and a consistent "Meets Expectations"
record may apply. Duration is 3 to 12 months.

## Terms
Sabbaticals are unpaid. Group insurance continues during the sabbatical. Seniority and
leave accrual continue but no salary is paid.

## Application and Approval
Applications require a six-month notice, manager endorsement, HRBP approval and business
head sign-off. Approval is discretionary, not an entitlement.

## Rejoining
Employees rejoin at the same grade in an available role. The bank does not guarantee the
same role or team.

Policy code: HR-SAB-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Management team.

# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

# HR Operations Leave Planning Guide 2026

## Purpose

This guide helps HR Operations teams plan leave without compromising coverage during peak periods such as appraisal and year-end cycles.

## Planning Rules

Privileged leave needs at least 7 working days of notice and manager approval.

At least 70 percent of the team must be available during declared peak windows.

Backfill plans must be agreed before overlapping leave is approved.

## Seasonal Guidance

Anticipate demand around appraisal and year-end cycles and open early leave planning.

Rotate preferred holiday weeks across the team from year to year.

## Manager Duties

Publish the unit leave calendar quarterly.

Review pending balances and prompt planned usage.

Escalate conflicts to the HR business partner.

## Policy code

HR-LVG-HROPS-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations.

All permanent employees except HR recruiters and the hiring manager for the specific role

Referral rewards are paid in two instalments: 50 percent on joining and 50 percent after

published in the quarterly referral bulletin.

is found to violate the anti-nepotism policy.

## Referral Process
1. Register the candidate in the referral portal.
2. Candidate is tagged to the employee for 180 days.
3. On selection, the referral bonus is processed automatically.

# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.

- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S3] Who can apply for job rotation?
Q: Who can apply for job rotation?
A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

[S4] Background Verification
# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

[S5] Leave Policy 2026
# Leave Policy — 2026

## Applicability
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Axis Bank across corporate offices,
branches and contact centres. Contractual and third-party staff are governed by the
terms of their engagement contracts.

## Types of Leave

### Privileged Leave (PL)
- 24 working days per calendar year, credited quarterly (6 per quarter).
- Can be availed up to 3 times a year.
- Minimum block of 3 continuous days per instance.
- Requests must be raised on the HR self-service portal at least 7 working days in
  advance for domestic travel and 14 working days for international travel.
- Unused PL carries forward up to a cap of 60 days.

### Casual Leave (CL)
- 8 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Cannot be carried forward.
- Maximum block of 2 continuous days.
- Requires reporting manager approval; can be applied on the same day for genuine
  emergencies.

### Sick Leave (SL)
- 12 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Medical certificate mandatory for any block of 3 or more continuous days.
- Cannot be carried forward.

### Maternity Leave
- 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children.
- 12 weeks of paid leave from the third child onwards.
- Adoption leave of 12 weeks for children below 3 months of age.
- Requests must be raised at least 8 weeks before the expected date, with the
  medical certificate attached.

### Paternity Leave
- 10 working days of paid leave available within 90 days of the child's birth.
- Can be split into 2 blocks.

### Bereavement Leave
- 5 working days for immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling).
- 2 working days for extended family.

## Compensatory Off
- Employees working on declared holidays are eligible for compensatory off within 45 days.
- Compensatory off cannot be encashed.

## Encashment
- On separation, up to 60 days of PL balance is encashed at basic + DA.
- CL and SL are not encashable.

## Escalation
For any dispute regarding leave balance, raise a ticket on HResponse under
`HR > Leave Balance`. First-level SLA is 2 business days.

[S5] Leave Policy 2026
# Leave Policy — 2026

## Applicability
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Axis Bank across corporate offices,
branches and contact centres. Contractual and third-party staff are governed by the
terms of their engagement contracts.

## Types of Leave

### Privileged Leave (PL)
- 24 working days per calendar year, credited quarterly (6 per quarter).
- Can be availed up to 3 times a year.
- Minimum block of 3 continuous days per instance.
- Requests must be raised on the HR self-service portal at least 7 working days in
  advance for domestic travel and 14 working days for international travel.
- Unused PL carries forward up to a cap of 60 days.

### Casual Leave (CL)
- 8 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Cannot be carried forward.
- Maximum block of 2 continuous days.
- Requires reporting manager approval; can be applied on the same day for genuine
  emergencies.

### Sick Leave (SL)
- 12 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Medical certificate mandatory for any block of 3 or more continuous days.
- Cannot be carried forward.

### Maternity Leave
- 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children.
- 12 weeks of paid leave from the third child onwards.
- Adoption leave of 12 weeks for children below 3 months of age.
- Requests must be raised at least 8 weeks before the expected date, with the
  medical certificate attached.

### Paternity Leave
- 10 working days of paid leave available within 90 days of the child's birth.
- Can be split into 2 blocks.

### Bereavement Leave
- 5 working days for immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling).
- 2 working days for extended family.

## Compensatory Off
- Employees working on declared holidays are eligible for compensatory off within 45 days.
- Compensatory off cannot be encashed.

## Encashment
- On separation, up to 60 days of PL balance is encashed at basic + DA.
- CL and SL are not encashable.

## Escalation
For any dispute regarding leave balance, raise a ticket on HResponse under
`HR > Leave Balance`. First-level SLA is 2 business days.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S3] Who can apply for job rotation?
Q: Who can apply for job rotation?
A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

[S4] Employee Referral Program
# Employee Referral Programme

## Eligibility
All permanent employees except HR recruiters and the hiring manager for the specific role
may refer candidates. Referrals must be registered in the referral portal before application.

## Reward Structure
Referral rewards are paid in two instalments: 50 percent on joining and 50 percent after
the referred employee completes six months. Senior and niche roles carry higher rewards as
published in the quarterly referral bulletin.

## Clawback
Rewards are clawed back if the referred employee exits within six months or if the referral
is found to violate the anti-nepotism policy.

## Referral Process
1. Register the candidate in the referral portal.
2. Candidate is tagged to the employee for 180 days.
3. On selection, the referral bonus is processed automatically.

Policy code: HR-REF-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

[S2] Rehiring Policy
# Re-Hiring Policy

## Purpose
This policy defines the criteria under which former employees ("alumni") may be
considered for rehire into Axis Bank.

## Eligibility
An alumnus may be considered for re-hire if all of the following are true:
1. The employee resigned or superannuated from Axis Bank in good standing.
2. There was no adverse audit or disciplinary finding at the time of exit.
3. A cooling period of at least 12 months has elapsed since the exit date.
4. The role being considered is at or below the last held grade at the bank.

## Non-Eligibility
An alumnus is NOT eligible for re-hire if any of the following are true:
- Exit was due to a "termination for cause" or breach of code of conduct.
- The employee is currently under a signed non-solicitation clause with a
  competitor and the clause is unexpired.
- Alumnus was identified as a "Do Not Rehire" during exit interviews.

## Approval Workflow
Every re-hire must be signed off by:
- HR Business Partner for the hiring unit.
- Business head at N-1 to CEO.
- Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

## Compensation
- Compensation for rehires is decided based on the target role and market band.
- Prior tenure is counted only for:
  - Gratuity computation.
  - Long-service awards.
- Prior tenure does NOT confer any accrued privileged leave or accumulated PF.

## Exceptions
Exceptions must be endorsed by the CEO and are limited to strategic hires
(business heads, technology leadership, key regulatory roles).

## References
- Policy code: HR-REHIRE-2026-01
- Last reviewed: March 2026
- Owner: HR Business Policy team

[S3] Who can apply for job rotation?
Q: Who can apply for job rotation?
A: Employees meeting the eligibility criteria in the policy; check the posting for specifics.

[S4] Employee Referral Program
# Employee Referral Programme

## Eligibility
All permanent employees except HR recruiters and the hiring manager for the specific role
may refer candidates. Referrals must be registered in the referral portal before application.

## Reward Structure
Referral rewards are paid in two instalments: 50 percent on joining and 50 percent after
the referred employee completes six months. Senior and niche roles carry higher rewards as
published in the quarterly referral bulletin.

## Clawback
Rewards are clawed back if the referred employee exits within six months or if the referral
is found to violate the anti-nepotism policy.

## Referral Process
1. Register the candidate in the referral portal.
2. Candidate is tagged to the employee for 180 days.
3. On selection, the referral bonus is processed automatically.

Policy code: HR-REF-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

[S5] Background Verification
# Background Verification Policy

## Scope
Background verification applies to all new joiners, temporary staff and vendor personnel
with system access. Verification is completed within 60 days of joining.

## Checks Performed
- Identity and address verification against Officially Valid Documents.
- Education and employment history for the last seven years.
- Criminal and court-record check.
- Credit check for roles with fiduciary or cash-handling responsibilities.

## Adverse Findings
Discrepancies are reviewed by the verification cell and HRBP. Material misrepresentation in
education or employment history may lead to withdrawal of the offer or termination.

## Re-Verification
Employees moving to roles requiring higher clearance undergo re-verification before the
transfer is effective.

Policy code: HR-BGV-2026-01 | Owner: Talent Acquisition team.

- Leadership (M6-M7): business-unit and function ownership.

travel per diem.

# Process Checklist: Reimbursement Claim

## Entry Point

Start the process from HR portal > Pay > Reimbursements.

## Checklist

1. Confirm eligibility per the policy before starting.

2. Prepare the supporting documents listed in the form.

3. Obtain the required manager or HR approvals.

4. Submit and note the reference number.

5. Track the request and respond to queries within 2 business days.

## Common Rejections

Missing documents, incomplete fields, or approvals outside the authority matrix.

## SLA

Standard requests complete within 5 business days unless the policy states otherwise.

## Policy code

HR-CHK-REIMB-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations.

[S4] Full And Final Settlement
# Full & Final Settlement

## Components
F&F includes salary for days worked, leave encashment as per policy, variable pay where
eligible, gratuity where applicable and recovery of dues.

## Timeline
F&F is processed within 45 days of the last working day, subject to receipt of no-dues
certificate and asset return.

## Recoveries
Notice-period shortfall, outstanding advances, relocation recovery and excess leave are
recovered from the settlement.

## Form 16 & Documents
The relieving letter is issued with the settlement. Form 16 for the current year is
issued in June as per statute.

Policy code: HR-FNF-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations team.

USER QUESTION:
For my situation, what is the monthly local-conveyance cap for an M1 employee?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Accommodation Norms
# Hotel & Accommodation Norms

## City-wise Caps
Metro cities: INR 8,000 per night. Tier-1 cities: INR 6,000 per night. Other cities:
INR 4,500 per night. Caps include taxes.

## Booking Preference
Accommodation must be booked through the approved corporate travel platform. Direct
bookings are reimbursed only with prior approval and valid justification.

## Shared Stay
Employees travelling together may share rooms for internal meetings. Room-sharing norms
apply only with mutual consent and are never mandatory.

## Invoice Requirements
Submit a GST invoice in the employee's name along with the stay dates. Payments to
unregistered properties are not reimbursable.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-H-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S2] Meal And Incidental Allowance
# Meal & Incidental Allowance

## Daily Allowance
Meal and incidental allowance is paid as a fixed per diem based on travel city category:
Metro INR 1,200, Tier-1 INR 1,000, others INR 800 per day.

## Coverage
The per diem covers meals, local conveyance within the destination city and personal
incidentals. It does not cover alcohol, personal shopping or entertainment.

## Half-day Rule
A travel day spanning more than 8 hours qualifies for full per diem. Days with 4-8 hours
qualify for half per diem.

## Payment
Per diem is paid with the expense settlement, not in advance, unless included in an
approved travel advance.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-M-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Salary Reimbursement
# Salary Reimbursement Policy

## Coverage
This policy covers reimbursement of pre-approved business expenses paid out of
the employee's own pocket. Categories include local conveyance, client
entertainment, mobile / broadband, professional membership fees and business
travel per diem.

## Submission Window
- Claims must be submitted within **30 calendar days** of the expense date.
- Claims older than 60 days are auto-rejected by the system.
- Claims raised between 30 and 60 days require reporting manager + HRBP
  approval.

## Required Documentation
- Original receipt or GST-compliant invoice.
- Purpose note describing the business reason.
- For entertainment claims: list of attendees and their designation.
- For travel: boarding pass copies for flights, e-tickets for train and
  approved travel request ID.

## Category Caps (INR, monthly)
| Grade | Local conveyance | Client entertainment | Mobile / broadband |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M1 | 3,000 | 5,000 | 1,000 |
| M2 | 5,000 | 10,000 | 1,500 |
| M3 | 8,000 | 20,000 | 2,000 |
| M4+ | 12,000 | Actuals | 2,500 |

## Approval Flow
Employee → Reporting Manager → HRBP → Finance Payments.
Payouts credit the salary account within 5 business days of Finance approval.

## Escalation
For payout delays beyond SLA, log a Unidesk ticket under
`HR > Reimbursement > Payout Delay`.

## Policy Code
`HR-REIMB-2026-02` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] Domestic Travel Policy
# Domestic Travel Policy

## Booking Rules
- Flights: economy class for grades M1-M3, business class only for M4 and above with
  business-head approval.
- Trains: AC two-tier or equivalent.
- Cabs: app-based or approved vendor with bills.

## Travel Request
Travel must be approved in the travel portal before booking. International and emergency
travel have separate workflows.

## Per Diem
Daily allowance covers meals and local conveyance. Actual hotel bills are reimbursed
separately up to city-wise caps published in the travel annexure.

## Expense Submission
Submit expense claims within 15 days of return. Unsubmitted travel advances are recovered
from the next salary.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S5] Grade Structure
# Grade & Band Structure

## Band Framework
Grades M1-M7 define individual contributor and managerial levels. Each band has a defined
salary range, role cluster and expected scope.

## Band Movement
Band movement is by promotion or regrading only. Regrading changes the band of a role, not
the employee's performance-based progression.

## Role Clusters
- Individual contributor (M1-M3): execution and subject-matter expertise.
- People manager (M4-M5): team delivery and development.
- Leadership (M6-M7): business-unit and function ownership.

## Salary Range Governance
Offers and increments must stay within band ranges. Exceptions need HRBP and business-head
approval with documented market rationale.

Policy code: HR-GRADE-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards team.

ASSISTANT: Claims must be submitted within 30 calendar days of the expense date.
USER: For my situation, what happens to reimbursement claims older than 60 days?
ASSISTANT: Claims older than 60 days are auto-rejected by the system.

Compose the final answer now.
