[S1] Who is responsible in the approval stage?
Q: Who is responsible in the approval stage?
A: The change owner drives the stage; the Change Management Office governs.

[S2] Impact Assessment Checklist
# Impact Assessment Checklist

## Dimensions
- Customer: which journeys and channels are affected.
- Systems: upstream and downstream dependencies.
- Data: schema, migration and retention impact.
- Regulatory: reporting and audit implications.
- Operations: runbook and support readiness.

## Scoring
Changes are scored low, medium or high risk from the assessment. Score
drives the approval route.

## Review
Assessments are reviewed by a peer outside the delivery team for bias.

Policy code: CR-IA-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Approval Matrix
# Change Approval Matrix

## Approval Levels
- Standard: team lead.
- Normal, medium risk: CAB with business representative.
- Normal, high risk: CAB plus business head.
- Emergency: two on-call approvers.

## Segregation
Implementers cannot approve their own changes. Approvers must be outside
the delivery team.

## Evidence
Approvals are recorded in the tool with timestamps and approver identity.

## Delegation
Approval delegation is defined per role in the matrix and reviewed
annually.

Policy code: CR-APPR-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S4] Who authorises emergency approval?
Q: Who authorises emergency approval?
A: The on-call approvers per the emergency matrix.

[S5] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

Q: Who is responsible in the approval stage?

# Impact Assessment Checklist

## Dimensions
- Customer: which journeys and channels are affected.
- Systems: upstream and downstream dependencies.
- Data: schema, migration and retention impact.
- Regulatory: reporting and audit implications.
- Operations: runbook and support readiness.

## Scoring
Changes are scored low, medium or high risk from the assessment. Score
drives the approval route.

## Review
Assessments are reviewed by a peer outside the delivery team for bias.

Policy code: CR-IA-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Approval Matrix
# Change Approval Matrix

## Approval Levels
- Standard: team lead.
- Normal, medium risk: CAB with business representative.
- Normal, high risk: CAB plus business head.
- Emergency: two on-call approvers.

## Segregation
Implementers cannot approve their own changes. Approvers must be outside
the delivery team.

## Evidence
Approvals are recorded in the tool with timestamps and approver identity.

## Delegation
Approval delegation is defined per role in the matrix and reviewed
annually.

Policy code: CR-APPR-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

Q: Who authorises emergency approval?
A: The on-call approvers per the emergency matrix.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S2] How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
Q: How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

[S3] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S4] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S5] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

Compose the final answer now.

[S1] Environment Strategy
# Environment Strategy

## Environments
Dev, QA, staging and production with defined promotion rules.

## Parity
Staging mirrors production configuration for the change class being
tested. Drift is reconciled before deployment.

## Data
Test environments use masked or synthetic data. Production data in
non-production environments requires approval.

## Access
Environment access follows least privilege; production access is
break-glass controlled.

Policy code: CR-ENV-2026-01 | Owner: Release Management Office.

[S2] Gen Freeze Note Hy
# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S4] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

[S3] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S4] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S5] What evidence is required for configuration change?
Q: What evidence is required for configuration change?
A: Automated logs plus a post-change confirmation note.

Compose the final answer now.

# Environment Strategy

## Environments
Dev, QA, staging and production with defined promotion rules.

# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

## Standard Windows
Production deployments run in the night maintenance window: 00:00 to

# Impact Assessment Checklist

## Dimensions
- Customer: which journeys and channels are affected.
- Systems: upstream and downstream dependencies.
- Data: schema, migration and retention impact.
- Regulatory: reporting and audit implications.
- Operations: runbook and support readiness.

## Scoring
Changes are scored low, medium or high risk from the assessment. Score
drives the approval route.

## Review
Assessments are reviewed by a peer outside the delivery team for bias.

Policy code: CR-IA-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] Change Approval Matrix
# Change Approval Matrix

## Approval Levels
- Standard: team lead.
- Normal, medium risk: CAB with business representative.
- Normal, high risk: CAB plus business head.
- Emergency: two on-call approvers.

## Segregation
Implementers cannot approve their own changes. Approvers must be outside
the delivery team.

## Evidence
Approvals are recorded in the tool with timestamps and approver identity.

## Delegation
Approval delegation is defined per role in the matrix and reviewed
annually.

Policy code: CR-APPR-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

Q: Who authorises emergency approval?
A: The on-call approvers per the emergency matrix.

[S4] Who is responsible in the approval stage?
Q: Who is responsible in the approval stage?
A: The change owner drives the stage; the Change Management Office governs.

[S5] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S1] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S2] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
Q: How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

[S4] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S5] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

Compose the final answer now.

|---|---|

# Change Approval Matrix

## Approval Levels
- Standard: team lead.
- Normal, medium risk: CAB with business representative.
- Normal, high risk: CAB plus business head.
- Emergency: two on-call approvers.

## Segregation
Implementers cannot approve their own changes. Approvers must be outside
the delivery team.

## Evidence
Approvals are recorded in the tool with timestamps and approver identity.

## Delegation
Approval delegation is defined per role in the matrix and reviewed
annually.

Policy code: CR-APPR-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Impact Assessment Checklist
# Impact Assessment Checklist

## Dimensions
- Customer: which journeys and channels are affected.
- Systems: upstream and downstream dependencies.
- Data: schema, migration and retention impact.
- Regulatory: reporting and audit implications.
- Operations: runbook and support readiness.

## Scoring
Changes are scored low, medium or high risk from the assessment. Score
drives the approval route.

## Review
Assessments are reviewed by a peer outside the delivery team for bias.

Policy code: CR-IA-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S4] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S5] Who authorises emergency approval?
Q: Who authorises emergency approval?
A: The on-call approvers per the emergency matrix.

USER: For my situation, are production changes allowed during year-end close? (ref VBLK-0135)
ASSISTANT: No. Non-emergency production changes are frozen during year-end and half-yearly close windows.

USER QUESTION:
What are the mandatory fields of a Change Request? (ref VBLK-0136)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S3] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

[S4] How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
Q: How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

[S5] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

Compose the final answer now.

# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] Environment Strategy
# Environment Strategy

## Environments
Dev, QA, staging and production with defined promotion rules.

## Parity
Staging mirrors production configuration for the change class being
tested. Drift is reconciled before deployment.

## Data
Test environments use masked or synthetic data. Production data in
non-production environments requires approval.

## Access
Environment access follows least privilege; production access is
break-glass controlled.

Policy code: CR-ENV-2026-01 | Owner: Release Management Office.

[S3] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

# Environment Strategy

## Environments

Test environments use masked or synthetic data. Production data in
non-production environments requires approval.

Environment access follows least privilege; production access is
break-glass controlled.

arbitrates based on business priority.

The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

[S1] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S3] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

[S4] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S5] How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
Q: How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

Compose the final answer now.

# Environment Strategy

## Environments
Dev, QA, staging and production with defined promotion rules.

Staging mirrors production configuration for the change class being

# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

Q: Who enforces the year-end freeze?
A: The Change Management Office with release management.

Please clarify: who approves a regulatory or customer-facing change? (ref VBLK-0137)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Impact Assessment Checklist
# Impact Assessment Checklist

## Dimensions
- Customer: which journeys and channels are affected.
- Systems: upstream and downstream dependencies.
- Data: schema, migration and retention impact.
- Regulatory: reporting and audit implications.
- Operations: runbook and support readiness.

## Scoring
Changes are scored low, medium or high risk from the assessment. Score
drives the approval route.

## Review
Assessments are reviewed by a peer outside the delivery team for bias.

Policy code: CR-IA-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] Who is responsible in the approval stage?
Q: Who is responsible in the approval stage?
A: The change owner drives the stage; the Change Management Office governs.

[S3] Change Approval Matrix
# Change Approval Matrix

## Approval Levels
- Standard: team lead.
- Normal, medium risk: CAB with business representative.
- Normal, high risk: CAB plus business head.
- Emergency: two on-call approvers.

## Segregation
Implementers cannot approve their own changes. Approvers must be outside
the delivery team.

## Evidence
Approvals are recorded in the tool with timestamps and approver identity.

## Delegation
Approval delegation is defined per role in the matrix and reviewed
annually.

Policy code: CR-APPR-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S4] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S5] Who authorises emergency approval?
Q: Who authorises emergency approval?
A: The on-call approvers per the emergency matrix.

USER: Please clarify: what are the mandatory fields of a Change Request? (ref VBLK-0137)
ASSISTANT: Business justification, impact assessment, roll-back plan with owner and time budget, test evidence, communication plan, and downtime window if any.
USER: Please clarify: are production changes allowed during year-end close? (ref VBLK-0137)
ASSISTANT: No. Non-emergency production changes are frozen during year-end and half-yearly close windows.

Compose the final answer now.

[S1] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S2] How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
Q: How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

[S3] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S4] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

[S5] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

Compose the final answer now.

# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S4] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

## Required Evidence
- Unit and integration test results.
- UAT sign-off by business stakeholders.
- Performance test results for changes affecting critical paths.
- Regression suite outcome.

## Standards
Evidence must be attributable (tester, environment, date) and attached
to the change record.

## Sampling
The Change Management Office samples evidence for quality; gaps return
the change to review.

Policy code: CR-TEST-2026-01 | Owner: Quality Assurance.

A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

# Change Request Lifecycle

## Stages
1. Draft: business case and impact assessment.
2. Review: technical and risk review with peer checks.
3. Approval: CAB or emergency CAB as applicable.
4. Implementation: within the approved window.
5. Post-implementation review and closure.

## State Transitions
Only approved roles may move a CR between states. Every transition is
logged with the actor and timestamp.

## Rejection and Rework
Rejected CRs are returned with reasons. Reworked CRs re-enter review
without losing history.

## Closure
A CR closes only after successful implementation, rollback readiness expiry
and documentation of outcomes.

Policy code: CR-LIFE-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

USER QUESTION:
Could you confirm: what are the mandatory fields of a Change Request? (ref VBLK-0139)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S2] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix

# Environment Strategy

Dev, QA, staging and production with defined promotion rules.

# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

# Deployment Windows

## Standard Windows
Production deployments run in the night maintenance window: 00:00 to
04:00 IST, unless otherwise approved.

## Exceptions
Customer-impacting daytime changes require business-head and CAB
approval with documented mitigation.

## Window Discipline
Deployments must complete within the window. Runaway deployments are
halted and rolled back per the runbook.

## Weekend Deployments
Weekend deployments are permitted only for approved releases and require
on-call support coverage.

Policy code: CR-WIN-2026-01 | Owner: Release Management Office.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

[S2] Cr Templates
# CR Templates & Mandatory Fields

## Standard Template
- Change title and unique ID.
- Category: standard, normal, emergency.
- Business justification and impacted services.
- Risk assessment and rollback plan.
- Implementation window and owner.

## Field Completeness
A CR cannot be submitted with missing mandatory fields. The tool validates
completeness before routing.

## Evidence Attachments
Test results, approvals and communication drafts attach to the CR before
CAB review.

## Template Updates
Templates are reviewed annually by the Change Management Office.

Policy code: CR-TPL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
Q: How do I raise a Change Request (CR) for a policy update?
A: Log a CR in the Change Management portal. Attach the impact assessment, business justification and roll-back plan. CRs affecting production data require CAB approval.

[S4] How is configuration change treated?
Q: How is configuration change treated?
A: For configuration change: pre-approved for defined parameters; deviations need CAB review.

[S5] What approvals are needed for configuration change?
Q: What approvals are needed for configuration change?
A: Pre-approved by CAB through the standard-change template.

# Change Freeze Note: Half-Year Close

## Freeze Window

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

The Half-Year Close freeze covers last 3 business days of September.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-HY-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S3] Change Calendar
# Change Calendar Management

## Purpose
The calendar sequences approved changes to avoid resource conflicts and
landing-zone contention.

## Slotting Rules
- No more than the prescribed number of production changes per window.
- Dependency-linked changes are scheduled together.
- High-risk changes are isolated from other high-risk changes.

## Conflict Resolution
Calendar conflicts are escalated to the Change Management Office, which
arbitrates based on business priority.

## Visibility
The calendar is published and visible to all delivery teams.

Policy code: CR-CAL-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

## Freeze Window

The Financial Year-End freeze covers last 5 business days of March.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

## Preparation

Complete planned changes before the freeze starts.

Confirm rollback readiness and on-call rosters.

## Policy code

CR-FZ-YE-2026-01 | Owner: Change Management Office.

[S5] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

## Access
The Download portal is available from the intranet home page and the
वार्तालाप Download bubble.

Search by form name, form code or process. Results show the latest version,
effective date and owning department.

[S1] Statutory Forms Index
# Statutory Forms Index

## FEMA & Remittance
- FEMA-DEC-01: FEMA declaration for inward remittances.
- RBI-INR-05: INR reporting for cross-border trade.

## KYC & FATCA
- KYC-INDV-01: Individual KYC application.
- KYC-CORP-01: Corporate KYC application.
- FATCA-CRS-01: FATCA/CRS self-certification.

## Accounts
- SIG-CHG-01: Signature change request.
- NOM-01: Nomination for savings/current/FD.

## Succession
- CLAIM-SET-01: Claim settlement documentation checklist.

Policy code: DL-STAT-2026-01 | Owner: Compliance.

[S2] Where can I download the FEMA declaration form?
Q: Where can I download the FEMA declaration form?
A: Go to the Download tab and choose 'Forms & Annexure > FEMA Declaration'. The latest version is dated 2026-04.

[S3] Forms Index
# Forms & Annexure — Download Index

Use the **Download** bubble in the chat to search for a form by name. This
page lists the most requested forms and where to find them.

## HR Forms
- `HR-LEAVE-01` — Special leave application (path: Download > HR > Leave)
- `HR-REIMB-01` — Salary reimbursement claim (Download > HR > Reimbursement)
- `HR-PF-NOM-1` — Provident Fund nomination
- `HR-GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination

## Statutory Forms
- `FEMA-DEC-01` — FEMA declaration for inward remittances
- `FATCA-CRS-01` — FATCA / CRS self-certification
- `RBI-INR-05` — INR reporting for cross-border trade

## Customer Journey Forms
- `KYC-INDV-01` — Individual KYC application
- `KYC-CORP-01` — Corporate KYC application
- `SIG-CHG-01` — Signature change request
- `NOM-01` — Nomination request for savings / current / FD

## Support / IT
- `IT-SR-01` — Standard IT Service Request template
- `NW-VPN-01` — VPN access request template

## How to Download
1. Open the **Download** bubble in वार्तालाप.
2. Type the form name or the underlying process.
3. Click "Show Content" on the top source card to preview and download.

## Reference
`DL-IDX-2026-01` · Owner: Employee Services / Corporate Communications.

Could you confirm: which form do I use for a salary reimbursement claim?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Where can I download the salary reimbursement form?
Q: Where can I download the salary reimbursement form?
A: Download > HR Forms > Salary Reimbursement. Submit the completed form to your HR business partner within 30 days of the expense.

[S2] Forms Index
# Forms & Annexure — Download Index

Use the **Download** bubble in the chat to search for a form by name. This
page lists the most requested forms and where to find them.

## HR Forms
- `HR-LEAVE-01` — Special leave application (path: Download > HR > Leave)
- `HR-REIMB-01` — Salary reimbursement claim (Download > HR > Reimbursement)
- `HR-PF-NOM-1` — Provident Fund nomination
- `HR-GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination

## Statutory Forms
- `FEMA-DEC-01` — FEMA declaration for inward remittances
- `FATCA-CRS-01` — FATCA / CRS self-certification
- `RBI-INR-05` — INR reporting for cross-border trade

## Customer Journey Forms
- `KYC-INDV-01` — Individual KYC application
- `KYC-CORP-01` — Corporate KYC application
- `SIG-CHG-01` — Signature change request
- `NOM-01` — Nomination request for savings / current / FD

## Support / IT
- `IT-SR-01` — Standard IT Service Request template
- `NW-VPN-01` — VPN access request template

## How to Download
1. Open the **Download** bubble in वार्तालाप.
2. Type the form name or the underlying process.
3. Click "Show Content" on the top source card to preview and download.

## Reference
`DL-IDX-2026-01` · Owner: Employee Services / Corporate Communications.

# Forms & Annexure — Download Index

Use the **Download** bubble in the chat to search for a form by name. This
page lists the most requested forms and where to find them.

- `HR-LEAVE-01` — Special leave application (path: Download > HR > Leave)
- `HR-REIMB-01` — Salary reimbursement claim (Download > HR > Reimbursement)
- `HR-PF-NOM-1` — Provident Fund nomination
- `HR-GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination

## Statutory Forms
- `FEMA-DEC-01` — FEMA declaration for inward remittances
- `FATCA-CRS-01` — FATCA / CRS self-certification
- `RBI-INR-05` — INR reporting for cross-border trade

## Customer Journey Forms
- `KYC-INDV-01` — Individual KYC application
- `KYC-CORP-01` — Corporate KYC application
- `SIG-CHG-01` — Signature change request
- `NOM-01` — Nomination request for savings / current / FD

## Support / IT
- `IT-SR-01` — Standard IT Service Request template
- `NW-VPN-01` — VPN access request template

## How to Download
1. Open the **Download** bubble in वार्तालाप.
2. Type the form name or the underlying process.
3. Click "Show Content" on the top source card to preview and download.

`DL-IDX-2026-01` · Owner: Employee Services / Corporate Communications.

USER QUESTION:
What is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

Compose the final answer now.

# Travel Advance Policy

Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

# Full & Final Settlement

## Components
F&F includes salary for days worked, leave encashment as per policy, variable pay where
eligible, gratuity where applicable and recovery of dues.

## Timeline
F&F is processed within 45 days of the last working day, subject to receipt of no-dues
certificate and asset return.

## Recoveries
Notice-period shortfall, outstanding advances, relocation recovery and excess leave are
recovered from the settlement.

## Form 16 & Documents
The relieving letter is issued with the settlement. Form 16 for the current year is
issued in June as per statute.

# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.

- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

subject to prevailing rules.

Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

USER QUESTION:
Please clarify: what is the penalty for premature FD withdrawal?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S2] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S3] Travel Advance Policy
# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
Q: What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S1] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S3] How do I book a fixed deposit?
Q: How do I book a fixed deposit?
A: Log in to internet banking or the mobile app, choose Deposits > Book FD, pick tenure (7 days to 10 years), amount, and interest payout mode. Senior citizens get an extra 0.50 percent over the card rate.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: Tax Saver FD ki lock-in period kya hai?
ASSISTANT: The Tax Saver FD has a 5-year lock-in and qualifies for Section 80C deduction up to Rs 1.5 lakh.

Could you confirm: what is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.

- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.

- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.

- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.

  booking rate, whichever is lower.
