the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S3] How do I book a fixed deposit?
Q: How do I book a fixed deposit?
A: Log in to internet banking or the mobile app, choose Deposits > Book FD, pick tenure (7 days to 10 years), amount, and interest payout mode. Senior citizens get an extra 0.50 percent over the card rate.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

ASSISTANT: The Tax Saver FD has a 5-year lock-in and qualifies for Section 80C deduction up to Rs 1.5 lakh.

sources.title: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
sources.snippet:
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?

A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Travel Advance Policy
# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
Q: What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

[S5] Full And Final Settlement
# Full & Final Settlement

## Components
F&F includes salary for days worked, leave encashment as per policy, variable pay where
eligible, gratuity where applicable and recovery of dues.

## Timeline
F&F is processed within 45 days of the last working day, subject to receipt of no-dues
certificate and asset return.

## Recoveries
Notice-period shortfall, outstanding advances, relocation recovery and excess leave are
recovered from the settlement.

## Form 16 & Documents
The relieving letter is issued with the settlement. Form 16 for the current year is
issued in June as per statute.

Policy code: HR-FNF-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations team.

[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

ASSISTANT: The Tax Saver FD has a 5-year lock-in and qualifies for Section 80C deduction up to Rs 1.5 lakh.

# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

Please clarify: what is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD? (ref VBLK-0167)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S1] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S2] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S3] Travel Advance Policy
# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
Q: What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

USER: Please clarify: what extra rate do Senior Citizens get on FDs? (ref VBLK-0167)
ASSISTANT: An additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.

USER QUESTION:
I need guidance on this: what is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|

| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |

| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S4] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

[S5] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination

# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in

Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on

five-year minimum service condition.

# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S2] Travel Advance Policy
# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

USER QUESTION:
What is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD? (ref VBLK-0171)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|

| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

certificate and asset return.

Notice-period shortfall, outstanding advances, relocation recovery and excess leave are
recovered from the settlement.

## Form 16 & Documents
The relieving letter is issued with the settlement. Form 16 for the current year is
issued in June as per statute.

[S1] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S2] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S3] Who is eligible for fixed deposit?
Q: Who is eligible for fixed deposit?
A: Eligibility follows the scheme or product terms; KYC applies.

- RBI-INR-05: INR reporting for cross-border trade.

- FATCA-CRS-01: FATCA/CRS self-certification.

## Accounts

- NOM-01: Nomination for savings/current/FD.

## Succession
- CLAIM-SET-01: Claim settlement documentation checklist.

Policy code: DL-STAT-2026-01 | Owner: Compliance.

[S5] Who is eligible for regular savings?
Q: Who is eligible for regular savings?
A: Eligibility follows the product one-pager; KYC applies to all applicants.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
