I need guidance on this: what is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD? (ref VBLK-0173)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S4] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination

USER QUESTION:
I need guidance on this: what extra rate do Senior Citizens get on FDs? (ref VBLK-0173)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S4] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

## References
- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

[S5] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:

ASSISTANT: The Tax Saver FD has a 5-year lock-in and qualifies for Section 80C deduction up to Rs 1.5 lakh.

Compose the final answer now.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S2] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S3] Travel Advance Policy
# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S4] What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
Q: What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.

  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.

  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).

  at the notified rate.

joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S4] Retirement And Superannuation
# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

[S5] Performance Appraisal
# Performance Appraisal Cycle

## Cycle Timeline
| Phase | Window | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| Goal setting | 1 Apr – 30 Apr | Employee + reporting manager |
| Mid-year review | 1 Sep – 30 Sep | Employee + reporting manager |
| Self-appraisal | 1 Mar – 15 Mar | Employee |
| Manager appraisal | 16 Mar – 31 Mar | Reporting manager |
| Normalisation | 1 Apr – 15 Apr | Business-unit HRBP |
| Final letters | 20 Apr – 30 Apr | HR Operations |

## Rating Scale
| Rating | Label | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Outstanding | Exceptional, sustained impact well beyond role expectations. |
| 4 | Exceeds | Consistently exceeds expectations across most goals. |
| 3 | Meets | Meets all critical expectations. |
| 2 | Partially Meets | Meets some but not all critical expectations. |
| 1 | Below | Below expected performance; performance-improvement plan triggered. |

## Normalisation
- Ratings are normalised at the business-unit level with recommended distribution:
  Outstanding <= 8 %, Exceeds <= 25 %, Meets 55 – 65 %, Partially Meets <= 8 %,
  Below <= 4 %.
- Deviations require CHRO sign-off.

## PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
- Employees rated `Below` are placed on a 90-day PIP.
- HRBP reviews progress every 30 days.
- Continued rating of `Below` after PIP leads to separation.

- Policy code: HR-PMS-2026-01
- Owner: Talent Management team

[S1] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S2] Travel Advance Policy
# Travel Advance Policy

## Eligibility
Travel advance is issued for approved travel of five days or more. The advance covers
estimated stay, local conveyance and per diem.

## Advance Limits
Advances are capped at 80 percent of the estimated trip cost. Cash withdrawal of the
advance is capped as per the expense policy.

## Settlement
Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

## Multiple Trips
Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

Policy code: HR-TRVL-A-2026-01 | Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S4] What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
Q: What happens if we miss consent withdrawal?
A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

[S5] Certification Reimbursement
# Certification Reimbursement Policy

## Approved List
Reimbursement applies to certifications on the approved list published annually, such as
CAIIB, CFA, FRM, cloud certifications and role-specific technical certifications.

## Reimbursement Amount
Up to 100 percent of exam fees for certifications on the approved list, capped per grade.
Renewal and membership fees are reimbursed for active certifications.

## Conditions
- Certification must be passed, not merely attempted.
- Employee must be in service on the date of the claim.
- Reimbursement is paid against the fee receipt only.

## Bond
For certifications above the cap threshold, a service commitment of 12 months applies.
Early exit triggers pro-rata recovery.

USER QUESTION:
For my situation, what is the lock-in period of the Tax Saver FD? (ref VBLK-0175)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
Q: Can I break a Tax Saver FD before 5 years?
A: No. The 5-year Tax Saver FD has a statutory lock-in and cannot be broken until maturity. Regular FDs can be broken with a 1 percent penalty over the applicable rate.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S1] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S3] What is the rule for card eligibility?
Q: What is the rule for card eligibility?
A: For card eligibility: age 21 to 65, an income threshold by variant and a good bureau score.

[S4] How do I book a fixed deposit?
Q: How do I book a fixed deposit?
A: Log in to internet banking or the mobile app, choose Deposits > Book FD, pick tenure (7 days to 10 years), amount, and interest payout mode. Senior citizens get an extra 0.50 percent over the card rate.

# Retirement & Superannuation

## Retirement Age
Superannuation is at 60 years. Extensions may be offered for identified specialists in
one-year increments up to age 62, approved by the CHRO.

## Pension and Provident Fund
Statutory provident fund and pension scheme benefits are settled as per EPFO rules on
superannuation.

## Gratuity
Gratuity is payable as per the Payment of Gratuity Act on superannuation without the
five-year minimum service condition.

## Transition Support
A pre-retirement counselling session and benefits orientation are offered in the final
year of service.

Policy code: HR-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Benefits team.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement

# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: What is the minimum SIP amount for mutual funds?
ASSISTANT: The minimum SIP is Rs 500 per month, except direct-plan schemes where the factsheet applies.
USER: What is the SIP registration cut-off before the first debit?
ASSISTANT: SIP registration closes 8 days before the first debit date.

Compose the final answer now.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Exit Process

## Resignation
Resignation must be submitted in the HR portal with the intended last working day
respecting the notice period.

## Knowledge Transfer
The employee completes a handover document approved by the manager before exit. Access
revocation is initiated on the last working day.

An exit interview is conducted by HR for all voluntary separations. Feedback is
anonymised and aggregated.

## Asset Return
Laptop, ID card, tokens and other assets must be returned. Missing assets are recovered
at depreciated value from the final settlement.

Policy code: HR-EXIT-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations team.

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

USER QUESTION:
I need guidance on this: what is the minimum SIP amount for mutual funds?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).

- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

USER QUESTION:
For my situation, what is the minimum SIP amount for mutual funds?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.
