Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

[S5] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S1] Exit Process
# Exit Process

## Resignation
Resignation must be submitted in the HR portal with the intended last working day
respecting the notice period.

## Knowledge Transfer
The employee completes a handover document approved by the manager before exit. Access
revocation is initiated on the last working day.

## Exit Interview
An exit interview is conducted by HR for all voluntary separations. Feedback is
anonymised and aggregated.

## Asset Return
Laptop, ID card, tokens and other assets must be returned. Missing assets are recovered
at depreciated value from the final settlement.

Policy code: HR-EXIT-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations team.

[S2] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

A: Account opening or updation is deferred until documents are complete.

[S5] How does delivery issues redemption work?
Q: How does delivery issues redemption work?
A: For delivery issues: report within 7 days for redelivery or point credit.

[S3] Kyc Standard
# Know Your Customer (KYC) Standard

## Purpose
This standard defines the mandatory identity and address verification a
banker must perform before onboarding any customer, in line with the RBI
Master Direction on KYC.

## Acceptable Officially Valid Documents (OVDs)
- Aadhaar (with masked number, per UIDAI guideline).
- PAN.
- Passport.
- Driving licence issued by an RTO.
- Voter ID issued by ECI.
- Job card issued by NREGA duly signed by the state government.

## Video KYC (V-CIP)
V-CIP is available for eligible savings account onboarding subject to:
- Genuine live video with the customer visible from mid-torso up.
- Random challenge (e.g., "Show your OVD now").
- Officer capturing at least 3 still frames during the call.
- Geo-tagging of the customer's location.

## Periodic Update Frequency
| Risk Category | Frequency |
|---|---|
| High risk | Every 2 years |
| Medium risk | Every 8 years |
| Low risk | Every 10 years |

## Deficient KYC
Accounts flagged with deficient KYC are moved to `PARTIAL FREEZE` after
two written reminders. All debits (excluding regulatory / statutory dues)

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

Compose the final answer now.

An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any

Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).

3. KYC + FATCA declaration.

/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] What is the SIP registration cut-off?
Q: What is the SIP registration cut-off?
A: SIP registration cut-off is 8 calendar days before the first debit date. Pausing or cancelling a running SIP requires the request at least 2 working days before the debit date.

Compose the final answer now.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S4] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S5] What is the SIP registration cut-off?
Q: What is the SIP registration cut-off?
A: SIP registration cut-off is 8 calendar days before the first debit date. Pausing or cancelling a running SIP requires the request at least 2 working days before the debit date.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

advance is capped as per the expense policy.

Settlement must be completed within 15 days of return. Unsettled advances are recovered
from the next payroll and flagged to the manager.

Employees with an outstanding unsettled advance cannot raise a new advance unless the
pending amount is under INR 5,000.

What is the minimum SIP amount for mutual funds? (ref VBLK-0186)

[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S4] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S5] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

Compose the final answer now.

- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.

  breaking the mandate.

- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S4] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S5] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

# Exit Process

The employee completes a handover document approved by the manager before exit. Access
revocation is initiated on the last working day.

An exit interview is conducted by HR for all voluntary separations. Feedback is
anonymised and aggregated.

Laptop, ID card, tokens and other assets must be returned. Missing assets are recovered
at depreciated value from the final settlement.

[S4] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).

  breaking the mandate.

# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination

`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

[S1] Mutual Funds
# Mutual Funds — Advisor Playbook

## Product Suite
Axis Wealth offers execution-only and advisory access across the following
mutual fund categories:
- Equity: large-cap, flexi-cap, mid-cap, small-cap, ELSS, sector/thematic.
- Debt: liquid, ultra-short, money market, corporate bond, gilt, credit risk.
- Hybrid: aggressive, conservative, balanced advantage, multi-asset.
- International feeder funds (currency hedged and unhedged).

## Suitability Framework
An advisor must complete the customer's risk profile before recommending any
scheme:
1. Risk tolerance questionnaire (12 questions).
2. Time horizon and liquidity check.
3. KYC + FATCA declaration.
Recommendations must map to the resulting risk band (Conservative / Moderate
/ Aggressive). Deviations require written justification and a customer
consent letter.

## SIP Rules
- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

Compose the final answer now.

- Minimum SIP: ₹500/month (except direct-plan schemes; check factsheet).
- SIP registration cut-off: 8 days before first debit date.
- Pause / cancel SIP: T-2 working days before the debit date.
- Skipping instalments is allowed up to 3 months in a rolling year without
  breaking the mandate.

## Exit Load Ready-Reckoner
- Equity funds: 1% if redeemed within 12 months of allocation, nil after.
- Liquid funds: graded exit load from day 1 to day 7 as per SEBI norms.
- ELSS: statutory 3-year lock-in — no early exit permitted.

## Advisor Do & Don'ts
Do: disclose commission, provide TER details, share KIM before purchase.
Don't: guarantee returns, make comparisons with fixed deposits without a
disclaimer, or process transactions without a signed suitability report.

## Reference
`FA-MF-2026-01` · Owner: Wealth Advisory desk.

[S2] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

[S3] Nps Guide
# National Pension System (NPS) Guide

## Structure
NPS is a defined-contribution retirement scheme regulated by PFRDA with
tier-I (retirement) and tier-II (voluntary) accounts.

## Asset Classes
Equity, corporate bonds, government securities and alternate assets with
allocation caps per PFRDA rules. Active and auto choice available.

## Tax Benefits
Contributions under 80CCD(1)/(1B) within limits; employer contributions
under 80CCD(2).

## Exit Rules
On maturity, up to the prescribed percentage may be withdrawn lump-sum
with the balance annuitised.

## Suitability
NPS suits investors seeking market-linked, low-cost retirement
accumulation with annuitisation at maturity.

Advisory note: explain lock-in and annuity purchase requirement.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Ppf Scheme
# Public Provident Fund (PPF)

## Features
- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.
- Deposit range from the statutory minimum to maximum per financial year.
- Interest compounded annually at government-notified rates.

## Tax Benefits
Deposits qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are exempt,
subject to prevailing rules.

## Withdrawals and Loans
Partial withdrawals from the 7th year and loans from the 3rd year subject
to scheme rules.

## Premature Closure
Allowed only for specified life events (medical, education) per scheme
conditions.

Advisory note: PPF suits long-horizon tax-efficient accumulation.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.
