Product queries route to the product helpdesk via the CRM.

## Policy code

FA-NOTE-SAVINGS-2026-01 | Owner: Products & Advisory.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

Savings Accounts serve customers with daily-balance interest and variant-based value adds.

## Key Features

Features and limits are as per the current product master.

Interest, fees and charges follow the published tariff.

## Advisory Cues

Confirm the latest variant details before quoting to customers.

Explain fees and charges in plain language.

Document customer decisions and consent.

## Support

Product queries route to the product helpdesk via the CRM.

## Policy code

FA-NOTE-SAVINGS-2026-01 | Owner: Products & Advisory.

[S4] Fixed Deposits
# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

## Reference
`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

[S5] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

[S2] Bi Intro
# Conversational BI — Getting Started

## What It Is
The `Conversational BI` bubble routes natural-language questions to the
Text-to-SQL agent, which drafts SQL against the reporting data mart, executes
it read-only, and returns a formatted result set.

## Available Datasets
- `customers` — one row per customer, with segment, branch, onboarding date.
- `accounts` — one row per account, product, balance, status.
- `transactions` — one row per transaction, txn_type, channel, amount.

Additional derived views are added quarterly; see the DDL under
`FINANCIAL_ADVISOR/mutual_funds.md` etc. for illustrative examples.

## Good Prompts
- "How many customers opened SAVINGS accounts?"
- "Top 5 customers by savings balance in Mumbai branches."
- "Average NEFT transaction amount last month by channel."
- "List customers with dormant SAVINGS accounts and balance under 5000."

## Guardrails
The engine will refuse to run SQL that:
- Writes data (INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DROP / ALTER / ATTACH).
- References tables outside the whitelisted set.
- Returns more than 5,000 rows in a single call.

## Limitations
- Text2SQL cannot answer questions that depend on documents (use the RAG
  bubbles for those).
- It does not yet handle time-series joins across all history — restrict to
  90 days for stable results.

## Reference
`CBI-INTRO-2026-01` · Owner: BI Platform team.

[S1] Change Request Standard
# Change Request (CR) Standard

## Definition
A **Change Request** is any planned addition, modification or removal of a
production or production-adjacent component that could affect service
availability, integrity or compliance.

## CR Categories
| Category | Approval | Freeze windows apply? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard | Pre-approved template, no CAB | Yes |
| Normal | CAB approval | Yes |
| Emergency | Emergency CAB (E-CAB) | Yes, with waiver |

## Mandatory CR Fields
- Business justification.
- Impact assessment (services, users, data).
- Roll-back plan with owner and time budget.
- Test evidence (unit, integration, UAT sign-off).
- Communication plan.
- Downtime window (if any).

## Freeze Windows
No production CRs during:
- Financial year-end close (last week of March, first week of April).
- Half-yearly close (last week of September, first week of October).
- Regulatory reporting window (2 business days before submission deadline).

## Approval Matrix
| Change scope | Approver |
|---|---|
| Non-prod, single team | Team lead |
| Prod, single service | Service owner |
| Prod, cross-service or data | CAB |
| Regulatory / customer-facing | CAB + Compliance sign-off |

## References
- Standard code: CR-STD-2026-01
- Owner: Change Advisory Board (CAB) secretariat.

# Conversational BI — Getting Started

## What It Is
The `Conversational BI` bubble routes natural-language questions to the
Text-to-SQL agent, which drafts SQL against the reporting data mart, executes
it read-only, and returns a formatted result set.

## Available Datasets
- `customers` — one row per customer, with segment, branch, onboarding date.
- `accounts` — one row per account, product, balance, status.
- `transactions` — one row per transaction, txn_type, channel, amount.

Additional derived views are added quarterly; see the DDL under
`FINANCIAL_ADVISOR/mutual_funds.md` etc. for illustrative examples.

## Good Prompts
- "How many customers opened SAVINGS accounts?"
- "Top 5 customers by savings balance in Mumbai branches."
- "Average NEFT transaction amount last month by channel."
- "List customers with dormant SAVINGS accounts and balance under 5000."

## Guardrails
The engine will refuse to run SQL that:
- Writes data (INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DROP / ALTER / ATTACH).
- References tables outside the whitelisted set.
- Returns more than 5,000 rows in a single call.

## Limitations
- Text2SQL cannot answer questions that depend on documents (use the RAG
  bubbles for those).
- It does not yet handle time-series joins across all history — restrict to
  90 days for stable results.

## Reference
`CBI-INTRO-2026-01` · Owner: BI Platform team.

[S4] Savings Account Products
# Savings Account Products

## Product Range
- Basic savings: zero-balance variant per RBI guidelines.
- Regular savings with tiered interest.
- Salary accounts with bundled benefits.
- Premium savings with lifestyle and banking privileges.

## Eligibility
Resident individuals, HUFs in select variants, and minors through guardians.
NRI variants are offered under NRE/NRO schemes.

## Interest
Interest is credited quarterly based on daily balances, as per prevailing
rates published on the website.

## Value-Adds
Debit cards, digital banking, sweep facilities and insurance covers vary by
variant and are detailed in the product one-pager.

Advisory note: confirm the latest features from the product master before
quoting to customers.

[S5] Senior Citizen Savings
# Senior Citizen Savings Scheme

## Eligibility
Individuals aged 60 and above; 55-60 for those who retired under
superannuation/VRS within the prescribed rules.

## Features
- Tenure of 5 years, extendable once by 3 years.
- Quarterly interest at government-notified rates.
- Deposit limits per scheme rules; joint accounts with spouse allowed.

## Tax
Deposits qualify under Section 80C. Interest is taxable and subject to TDS.

## Premature Closure
Allowed with penalty after the first year except death cases.

Advisory note: compare SCSS with the Senior Citizens Savings and monthly
income options.

Compose the final answer now.

[S3] Bi Intro
# Conversational BI — Getting Started

## What It Is
The `Conversational BI` bubble routes natural-language questions to the
Text-to-SQL agent, which drafts SQL against the reporting data mart, executes
it read-only, and returns a formatted result set.

## Available Datasets
- `customers` — one row per customer, with segment, branch, onboarding date.
- `accounts` — one row per account, product, balance, status.
- `transactions` — one row per transaction, txn_type, channel, amount.

Additional derived views are added quarterly; see the DDL under
`FINANCIAL_ADVISOR/mutual_funds.md` etc. for illustrative examples.

## Good Prompts
- "How many customers opened SAVINGS accounts?"
- "Top 5 customers by savings balance in Mumbai branches."
- "Average NEFT transaction amount last month by channel."
- "List customers with dormant SAVINGS accounts and balance under 5000."

## Guardrails
The engine will refuse to run SQL that:
- Writes data (INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE / DROP / ALTER / ATTACH).
- References tables outside the whitelisted set.
- Returns more than 5,000 rows in a single call.

## Limitations
- Text2SQL cannot answer questions that depend on documents (use the RAG
  bubbles for those).
- It does not yet handle time-series joins across all history — restrict to
  90 days for stable results.

## Reference
`CBI-INTRO-2026-01` · Owner: BI Platform team.

# Fixed Deposits — Product Note

## Product Variants
- **Regular FD:** interest paid monthly / quarterly / on maturity.
- **Reinvestment FD:** compounded quarterly, single maturity payout.
- **Tax Saver FD:** 5-year lock-in, deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5L.
- **Senior Citizen FD:** additional 0.50% over the applicable card rate.
- **NRE / NRO FD:** available to NRIs subject to source-of-fund controls.

## Booking Channels
- Internet banking (retail).
- Mobile app.
- Any branch during business hours.
- Relationship manager for HNI customers.

## Premature Withdrawal
- Allowed on all variants except the 5-year Tax Saver FD.
- Penalty: 1.00% below the applicable card rate for the period run OR the
  booking rate, whichever is lower.
- Sweep-in FDs are broken in FIFO order to fund the linked savings account.

## Nomination
Nomination is mandatory. It can be captured at booking or updated later via
the branch or internet banking. Joint holdings must specify the operating
mandate (either or survivor / former or survivor / joint).

## Auto Renewal
Auto renewal defaults to `Reinvestment` at the prevailing rate for the same
tenure. Customers can switch this off during booking.

`FA-FD-2026-01` · Owner: Liabilities product team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

30-day review window.

# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.

multipliers.

boosted referral payouts and team leaderboards.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha FAQ

A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

USER QUESTION:
Could you confirm: what happens if a referred employee leave within 6 months?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Dispute Resolution
# Aha Dispute & Point Reversal

## Dispute Types
- Points not credited within the expected window.
- Clawbacks applied for referrals or wins.
- Redemption not delivered.

## Process
Raise a dispute in the portal under My Points > Raise Dispute with the
transaction reference. SLA is 5 business days.

## Point Reversal
Points are reversed where the underlying transaction is reversed: referral
exit within six months or invalidated cross-sell wins.

## Appeals
Unresolved disputes escalate to the Rewards & Recognition team with a
30-day review window.

Policy code: AHA-DIS-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

For my situation, how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] What is the rule on point earning?
Q: What is the rule on point earning?
A: The rule on point earning: referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and recognition earn points per the matrix.

[S4] Gen Campaign Pack Referral
# Campaign Pack: Referral Month

## Campaign Idea

boosted referral payouts and team leaderboards.

## Eligibility

All eligible employees per the campaign brief; actions auto-track.

## Points

Points and boosts follow the campaign matrix published on the portal.

## Timeline

Campaign runs for the calendar quarter; payout within 30 days of close.

## Support

The campaign helpdesk responds within 3 business days.

## Policy code

AHA-CP-REFERRAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition.

[S5] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |

- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: How many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0221)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

[S2] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: How many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0221)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.
USER: What is the minimum balance to redeem Aha points? (ref VBLK-0221)
ASSISTANT: 1,000 points.

Compose the final answer now.

Please clarify: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] What is the rule on point earning?
Q: What is the rule on point earning?
A: The rule on point earning: referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and recognition earn points per the matrix.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: Please clarify: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral?
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

[S2] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: Could you confirm: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0224)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

For my situation, when do Aha (AHA product suite) points expire?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Where do I see expiry?
Q: Where do I see expiry?
A: On the Aha dashboard under My Points.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

# Aha Dispute & Point Reversal

## Dispute Types
- Points not credited within the expected window.
- Clawbacks applied for referrals or wins.
- Redemption not delivered.

## Process
Raise a dispute in the portal under My Points > Raise Dispute with the
transaction reference. SLA is 5 business days.

## Point Reversal
Points are reversed where the underlying transaction is reversed: referral
exit within six months or invalidated cross-sell wins.

## Appeals
Unresolved disputes escalate to the Rewards & Recognition team with a
30-day review window.

# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.
