[S1] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: I need guidance on this: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0228)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

[S2] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: Could you confirm: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0229)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

USER QUESTION:
For my situation, how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0230)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] What is the rule on point earning?
Q: What is the rule on point earning?
A: The rule on point earning: referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and recognition earn points per the matrix.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

redemption profile setup.

featured redemptions.

Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

What happens if a referred employee leave within 6 months? (ref VBLK-0231)

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Dispute Resolution
# Aha Dispute & Point Reversal

## Dispute Types
- Points not credited within the expected window.
- Clawbacks applied for referrals or wins.
- Redemption not delivered.

## Process
Raise a dispute in the portal under My Points > Raise Dispute with the
transaction reference. SLA is 5 business days.

## Point Reversal
Points are reversed where the underlying transaction is reversed: referral
exit within six months or invalidated cross-sell wins.

## Appeals
Unresolved disputes escalate to the Rewards & Recognition team with a
30-day review window.

Policy code: AHA-DIS-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

boosted referral payouts and team leaderboards.

merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|

| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |

- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:

ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] What is the rule on point earning?
Q: What is the rule on point earning?
A: The rule on point earning: referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and recognition earn points per the matrix.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins

- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: Could you confirm: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0234)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

redemption profile setup.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

# Aha Points Earning Matrix

- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha FAQ

A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|

| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |

- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.

  branded merchandise.

- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

with catalogue updates.

to the registered address.

## Expiry

dashboard 60 days in advance.

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

[S1] How does the Aha referral bonus work?
Q: How does the Aha referral bonus work?
A: Successful employee referrals earn 5000 Aha points once the referred employee completes 6 months of service. Points are clawed back if the referred employee exits within 6 months.

[S2] Aha Dispute Resolution
# Aha Dispute & Point Reversal

## Dispute Types
- Points not credited within the expected window.
- Clawbacks applied for referrals or wins.
- Redemption not delivered.

## Process
Raise a dispute in the portal under My Points > Raise Dispute with the
transaction reference. SLA is 5 business days.

## Point Reversal
Points are reversed where the underlying transaction is reversed: referral
exit within six months or invalidated cross-sell wins.

## Appeals
Unresolved disputes escalate to the Rewards & Recognition team with a
30-day review window.

Policy code: AHA-DIS-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S1] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S3] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S4] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

Compose the final answer now.

[S1] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S2] Aha Portal Guide
# Aha Portal User Guide

## Login
Access the Aha portal with corporate credentials. First login prompts for a
redemption profile setup.

## Dashboard
The dashboard shows point balance, expiring points, recent transactions and
featured redemptions.

## Earning
Points accrue from referrals, cross-sell wins, certifications and
recognition as per the earning matrix.

## Redemption
Browse the catalogue, add items to the cart and check out. E-vouchers are
delivered by email; physical items ship to the registered address.

Policy code: AHA-PORTAL-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] Aha Points Earning Matrix
# Aha Points Earning Matrix

## Business Wins
- Successful referral hired: 5,000 points.
- Qualifying cross-sell win: 250 points per unit.
- Audit-clean month for branch/ops team: 500 points.

## Recognition
- Regional CSAT topper: 1,500 points.
- Spot award (manager-issued): 250-1,000 points.
- Long-service milestones: tiered as per tenure.

## Development
- Approved certification pass: 2,000 points.
- Knowledge-sharing session delivered: 300 points.

## Campaigns
Quarterly campaigns publish boosted categories with limited-period
multipliers.

Policy code: AHA-EARN-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S5] Aha Faq
# Aha FAQ

## Common Questions
Q: How do I check my balance?
A: The dashboard shows the current balance and the next expiring tranche.

Q: Can I transfer points?
A: No, points are non-transferable. Giving to approved causes is supported.

Q: What if I leave the bank?
A: Unredeemed points lapse on the last working day. Redeem before exit.

Q: Are points taxable?
A: Redemptions may attract perquisite taxation as per prevailing rules,
reflected in payroll.

Policy code: AHA-FAQ-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: Could you confirm: how many points do I earn for a successful employee referral? (ref VBLK-0239)
ASSISTANT: 5,000 points when the referred employee is hired.

Compose the final answer now.

[S2] Aha Redemption Catalogue
# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

Policy code: AHA-REDEEM-2026-01 | Owner: Rewards & Recognition team.

[S3] Aha Programme
# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

[S4] What is the rule on point expiry?
Q: What is the rule on point expiry?
A: The rule on point expiry: points expire 24 months after award with 60-day dashboard warnings.

  point reversal and disciplinary action.

# Aha — Employee Rewards Programme

## What is Aha?
Aha is the employee-facing rewards and recognition platform. Points are
earned through business-aligned actions and can be redeemed for vouchers,
merchandise and experiences on the Aha portal.

## Earning Points
| Trigger | Points |
|---|---|
| Successful employee referral hired | 5,000 |
| Cross-sell win (per qualifying win) | 250 |
| Audit-clean month (branch or ops team) | 500 |
| CSAT topping the region | 1,500 |
| Certification pass (approved list) | 2,000 |

## Redemption
- Minimum redemption balance: 1,000 points.
- Points expire 24 months after being awarded.
- Redemption catalogue: Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra vouchers, curated experiences,
  branded merchandise.

## Anti-Abuse Controls
- Referrals that leave within 6 months are clawed back automatically.
- Fake cross-sell entries are flagged during quarterly audit and lead to
  point reversal and disciplinary action.

## Support
For Aha portal issues, raise a ticket via HResponse under `Aha > Portal`.
For point disputes, use `Aha > Point Reversal`.

# Aha Dispute & Point Reversal

## Dispute Types
- Points not credited within the expected window.
- Clawbacks applied for referrals or wins.
- Redemption not delivered.

Raise a dispute in the portal under My Points > Raise Dispute with the
transaction reference. SLA is 5 business days.

## Point Reversal
Points are reversed where the underlying transaction is reversed: referral
exit within six months or invalidated cross-sell wins.

## Appeals
Unresolved disputes escalate to the Rewards & Recognition team with a
30-day review window.

[S2] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S2] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S3] Axis Phone Features
# Axis Phone Feature Overview

Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks

- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.

[S2] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the

Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# CSAT Survey Programme

## Trigger
An SMS survey follows every completed call and callback.

## Questions
One CSAT rating question, one agent-empathy question and an optional
comment.

## Targets
Channel CSAT targets are set quarterly. Results feed agent coaching and
process improvement.

## Closed Loop
Detractors receive a follow-up within 48 hours from the service recovery
team.

Policy code: A

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S2] Axis Phone Features
# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.
