[S1] Axis Phone Features
# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S2] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S3] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.

sources.title: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
sources.snippet:
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S2] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

An SMS survey follows every completed call and callback.

One CSAT rating question, one agent-empathy question and an optional
comment.

Channel CSAT targets are set quarterly. Results feed agent coaching and

Detractors receive a follow-up within 48 hours from the service recovery
team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S2] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S3] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

# Priority Customer Handling

## Tiers
Priority and Burgundy customers receive dedicated queues and shorter
callbacks.

## SLA
- Priority: callback within 15 minutes of the chosen slot.
- Retail: within 60 minutes.

## Dedicated Teams
Senior agents and relationship teams handle priority queues with warm
context handover from digital channels.

## Escalation
Unresolved priority interactions escalate to the relationship team within
24 hours.

Policy code: AP-PRIO-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

Q: What is the SLA around cancellation?
A: Priority within 15 minutes of the slot; retail within 60 minutes.

[S1] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S2] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the

Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S1] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
Q: How do I request a callback via Axis Phone?
A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

## Trigger
An SMS survey follows every completed call and callback.

## Questions
One CSAT rating question, one agent-empathy question and an optional
comment.

## Targets
Channel CSAT targets are set quarterly. Results feed agent coaching and
process improvement.

## Closed Loop
Detractors receive a follow-up within 48 hours from the service recovery
team.

Policy code: A

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks

- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.

[S3] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

# Priority Customer Handling

## Tiers
Priority and Burgundy customers receive dedicated queues and shorter
callbacks.

## SLA
- Priority: callback within 15 minutes of the chosen slot.
- Retail: within 60 minutes.

## Dedicated Teams
Senior agents and relationship teams handle priority queues with warm
context handover from digital channels.

## Escalation
Unresolved priority interactions escalate to the relationship team within
24 hours.

[S2] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

A: Choose the Axis Phone bubble, pick a 30-minute slot between 09:00 and 20:00 IST, confirm the callback number, and select the topic. You will get an SMS confirmation with the reference ID. Priority and Burgundy customers are called within 15 minutes of the slot.

[S2] Callback Workflow
# Axis Phone — Callback Workflow

## What is Axis Phone?
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where relationship managers and
contact-centre agents can be requested to call the customer back at a chosen
slot.

## Requesting a Callback (customer path)
1. Customer selects `Axis Phone` in the assistant or on the mobile app.
2. Provides preferred slot (30-minute windows between 09:00 and 20:00 IST).
3. Provides callback number (defaults to the number on file).
4. Selects the topic — `Account queries`, `Loan advisory`, `Cards`,
   `Wealth advisory`, `Complaint`, `Other`.
5. Receives an SMS confirmation with the callback reference ID.

## Assignment
The workflow engine picks an agent by:
- Topic → queue mapping.
- Customer segment (Retail / Priority / Burgundy).
- Language preference (English / Hindi / Regional).
- Agent load balancing — least-active-eligible agent wins.

## SLA
- Priority / Burgundy: **within 15 minutes** of the requested slot.
- Retail: **within 60 minutes**.
- Missed callbacks trigger an auto retry once and are flagged for supervisor
  review.

## Post-Call
- Agent must dispose the call with a valid outcome code and add the call
  summary in the CRM.
- CSAT survey SMS goes out within 30 minutes of call disposition.

## Reference
`AP-CB-2026-01` · Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S3] Axis Phone Features
# Axis Phone Feature Overview

## What It Is
Axis Phone is the assisted-service channel where customers request callbacks
from relationship managers and contact-centre agents.

## Core Features
- 30-minute callback slots between 09:00 and 20:00 IST.
- Topic-based routing: accounts, loans, cards, wealth, complaints.
- Language preference support including English, Hindi and regional languages.
- SMS confirmation with a callback reference ID.

## Channels
Callbacks can be requested from the mobile app, internet banking and the
वार्तालाप assistant.

Policy code: AP-OV-2026-01 | Owner: Assisted Channels team.

[S4] What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
Q: What if I miss my scheduled Axis Phone callback?
A: The system retries once automatically. If both attempts miss, the callback is flagged for supervisor review and rescheduled for the next business day.

[S3] Term Insurance Products
# Term Insurance Products

## Product
Pure protection life cover for a chosen term and sum assured.

## Variants
- Level term: fixed cover throughout.
- Increasing cover: grows with inflation-linked steps.
- Return of premium: refund of premiums on survival (higher premium).

## Key Features
High cover at low premium, riders for critical illness and accidental death,
and tax benefits under 80C and 10(10D).

## Underwriting
Medical underwriting based on age, health disclosures and habits.

Advisory note: recommend cover of 10-15x annual income as a starting rule.

[S4] What disclosures are mandatory for term insurance?
Q: What disclosures are mandatory for term insurance?
A: IRDAI-compliant disclosures from the product brochure; no promises beyond terms.

[S5] Ulip Overview
# Unit-Linked Insurance Plans (ULIP)

## Structure
ULIPs combine insurance cover with market-linked investment in equity,
debt or balanced funds.

## Key Parameters
- 5-year lock-in period.
- Fund switches allowed; charges include premium allocation, policy
  administration, fund management and mortality.

## Tax
Premiums under 80C (subject to conditions); maturity proceeds under
10(10D) subject to premium limits.

## Suitability
Long-horizon investors comfortable with market risk who want insurance
and investment in one product.

Advisory note: disclose all charges and compare with term-plus-MF
alternatives.

# Anti-Money Laundering (AML) — Operating Framework

## Purpose
The AML framework prevents the bank's channels being used to launder proceeds
of crime and to finance terrorism, in line with the Prevention of Money
Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002 and RBI Master Direction on KYC.

## Three Lines of Defence
- **1st line — Business units:** onboard customers correctly, monitor
  transactions, escalate red flags.
- **2nd line — Financial Crime Compliance (FCC):** owns the AML policy,
  runs the sanctions and PEP screening tools, files STRs.
- **3rd line — Internal Audit:** independently tests the framework annually.

## Customer Risk Categorisation
- **Low risk:** salaried resident individuals with no adverse hits.
- **Medium risk:** self-employed, high-net-worth individuals, non-resident
  individuals with low transaction velocity.
- **High risk:** NGOs, cash-intensive businesses, PEPs, customers in
  FATF-listed jurisdictions.

Risk category drives periodic KYC refresh frequency (see the KYC standard).

## Reporting Obligations
| Report | Threshold | Filing SLA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Transaction Report (CTR) | Cash > ₹10L / day per customer | 15th of the following month |
| Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) | On red flag | 7 working days from detection |
| Counterfeit Currency Report (CCR) | Any incident | 7 working days |
| Cross-Border Wire Transfer Report (CBWTR) | > ₹5L | 15th of the following month |

## Training
All customer-facing staff must complete the annual AML e-learning by
30 September of each year. Non-completion is tracked as an audit finding.

## Reference
`LAW-AML-2026-02` · Owner: Financial Crime Compliance unit.

# PMLA Obligations Overview

## Regulatory Basis
The Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 obligates the bank to detect,
deter and report money-laundering activity.

## Reporting Officers
The Principal Officer is responsible for filings with FIU-IND. Every business
unit designates a compliance liaison.

## Transaction Monitoring
Automated and rule-based monitoring flags unusual patterns: structuring,
rapid movement, high-risk jurisdiction flows and unexpected activity.

## Reporting Obligations
Cash Transaction Reports, Suspicious Transaction Reports, Counterfeit Currency
Reports and Cross-Border Wire Transfer Reports are filed within statutory
timelines.

## Training
All customer-facing staff complete annual AML training; completion is tracked
and audited.

Policy code: LAW-PMLA-2026-01 | Owner: Financial Crime Compliance.

# Anti-Money Laundering (AML) — Operating Framework

## Purpose
The AML framework prevents the bank's channels being used to launder proceeds
of crime and to finance terrorism, in line with the Prevention of Money
Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002 and RBI Master Direction on KYC.

## Three Lines of Defence
- **1st line — Business units:** onboard customers correctly, monitor
  transactions, escalate red flags.
- **2nd line — Financial Crime Compliance (FCC):** owns the AML policy,
  runs the sanctions and PEP screening tools, files STRs.
- **3rd line — Internal Audit:** independently tests the framework annually.

## Customer Risk Categorisation
- **Low risk:** salaried resident individuals with no adverse hits.
- **Medium risk:** self-employed, high-net-worth individuals, non-resident
  individuals with low transaction velocity.
- **High risk:** NGOs, cash-intensive businesses, PEPs, customers in
  FATF-listed jurisdictions.

Risk category drives periodic KYC refresh frequency (see the KYC standard).

## Reporting Obligations
| Report | Threshold | Filing SLA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Transaction Report (CTR) | Cash > ₹10L / day per customer | 15th of the following month |
| Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) | On red flag | 7 working days from detection |
| Counterfeit Currency Report (CCR) | Any incident | 7 working days |
| Cross-Border Wire Transfer Report (CBWTR) | > ₹5L | 15th of the following month |

## Training
All customer-facing staff must complete the annual AML e-learning by
30 September of each year. Non-completion is tracked as an audit finding.

## Reference
`LAW-AML-2026-02` · Owner: Financial Crime Compliance unit.

confirmation SMS link.

Missed callbacks

# Callback Scheduling Guide

## Slot Booking
Customers pick a 30-minute window between 09:00 and 20:00 IST on the next
five working days.

## Confirmation
An SMS confirms the slot with a reference ID. The agent sees the booking in
the agent console.

## Rescheduling
Customers can reschedule up to 30 minutes before the slot via the app or the
confirmation SMS link.

## Missed Calls
Missed callbacks retry once automatically, then flag for supervisor
follow-up the next business day.

# Personal Loans

## Product
Unsecured term loan for salaried and self-employed customers.

Loan amounts up to the approved multiple of income, tenure up to the
prescribed years, subject to policy.

Stable income, employer category, bureau score and debt-to-income ratio
within policy thresholds.

Processing fee, prepayment charges (post lock-in) and penal interest as per
the published tariff.

Disbursement follows documentation completion, credit approval and
agreement execution.

# Access Request Guide: VPN Gateway

## System Purpose

VPN Gateway provides remote connectivity.

## Access Levels

Standard user access maps to the role profile.

Elevated or administrator access requires additional justification.

## Request Flow

1. Raise the request in Unidesk under IT Helpdesk > Access.

2. Reporting manager approves.

3. InfoSec reviews for privileged access.

4. Provisioning completes within 2 business days.

## Reviews

Access is reviewed quarterly with the system owner.

## Policy code

IT-ACC-VPN-2026-01 | Owner: Identity & Access Management.

# Remote Desktop & VPN Access

## VPN Access
VPN connects remote users to internal applications. Access follows the VPN
request workflow with manager and InfoSec approval.

## Remote Desktop
Remote desktop into office workstations is available for approved roles via
the corporate remote-access tool.

## Security Rules
- Use the managed device only.
- Do not share sessions or credentials.
- Disconnect when done; sessions time out after inactivity.

## Troubleshooting
For disconnects, toggle network, restart the VPN client and retry. Persistent
issues raise a P2 ticket.

Policy code: IT-VPN-2026-01 | Owner: Network Operations.

VPN Gateway provides remote connectivity.

## Access Levels

Standard user access maps to the role profile.

Access is reviewed quarterly with the system owner.

# Remote Desktop & VPN Access

## VPN Access
VPN connects remote users to internal applications. Access follows the VPN
request workflow with manager and InfoSec approval.

## Remote Desktop
Remote desktop into office workstations is available for approved roles via
the corporate remote-access tool.

## Security Rules
- Use the managed device only.
- Do not share sessions or credentials.
- Disconnect when done; sessions time out after inactivity.

## Troubleshooting
For disconnects, toggle network, restart the VPN client and retry. Persistent
issues raise a P2 ticket.

Policy code: IT-VPN-2026-01 | Owner: Network Operations.

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How do I raise a laptop hardware issue?
Q: How do I raise a laptop hardware issue?
A: Log a ticket via Unidesk under IT Helpdesk > Hardware. Select 'Laptop' and describe the issue. On-site engineers respond within 4 hours for critical issues (screen not turning on, keyboard failure) and 1 business day otherwise.

[S2] How do I report a laptop issue?
Q: How do I report a laptop issue?
A: Log a Unidesk ticket under IT Helpdesk > Hardware with the asset tag and a description.

[S3] What is the SLA for laptop issues?
Q: What is the SLA for laptop issues?
A: The SLA for laptop issues is same-day triage, repair or replacement within 3 business days.

[S4] Laptop Upgrade Policy
# Laptop Upgrade Policy

## Upgrade Triggers
- Device older than 36 months.
- Performance issues verified by IT diagnostics.
- Role change requiring higher specifications.

## Request Flow
Raise a Unidesk request under IT Helpdesk > Hardware > Upgrade with business
justification. IT diagnostics confirm the requirement.

## Approval
Standard upgrades approve via the reporting manager. Out-of-cycle upgrades
require business-head approval.

## Swap Process
The old device is returned, data is migrated by IT, and the new device is
issued within 5 business days of approval.

Policy code: IT-LAP-U-2026-01 | Owner: End-User Computing.

[S5] Will I get a loaner laptop?
Q: Will I get a loaner laptop?
A: Loaners are available for critical roles while the device is under repair.

Compose the final answer now.

# SLA & Escalation Sheet: Laptop Support

## Severity Definitions

P1: Laptop Support unavailable for the whole team or a critical business area.

P2: significant degradation affecting part of the Laptop Support service.

P3: single-user issue with a workaround available.

## Response Targets

P1: response within 30 minutes, resolution within 2 hours.

P2: response within 2 hours, resolution within 8 hours.

P3: response within 4 business hours, resolution within 2 business days.

## Escalation Chain

1. Service desk (first point of contact).

2. Desk lead for SLA breaches.

3. IT service manager and the business owner for P1 events.

## Reporting

SLA performance publishes on the monthly service dashboard.

## Policy code

IT-SLA-LAPTOP-2026-01 | Owner: IT Service Management.

End-to-end support for Laptop Support: requests, incidents and guidance.

## How to Request

Raise a Unidesk ticket under IT Helpdesk with the employee ID and asset details.

Self-service options are available in the service catalogue where applicable.

## Service Hours

Standard support: 09:00 to 18:00 IST on working days.

Critical incidents: 24x7 through the security and operations desks.

## Escalation

Escalate SLA breaches to the desk lead, then the IT service manager.

## Policy code

IT-SVC-LAPTOP-2026-01 | Owner: IT Service Management.

RECENT CHAT HISTORY:
USER: How do I raise a laptop hardware issue?
ASSISTANT: Log a ticket via Unidesk under IT Helpdesk > Hardware. Select 'Laptop' and describe the issue. On-site engineers respond within 4 hours for critical issues (screen not turning on, keyboard failure) and 1 business day otherwise.
USER: How do I report a laptop issue?
ASSISTANT: Log a Unidesk ticket under IT Helpdesk > Hardware with the asset tag and a description.

Compose the final answer now.

# SLA & Escalation Sheet: Laptop Support

## Severity Definitions

P1: Laptop Support unavailable for the whole team or a critical business area.

P2: significant degradation affecting part of the Laptop Support service.

P3: single-user issue with a workaround available.

## Response Targets

P1: response within 30 minutes, resolution within 2 hours.

P2: response within 2 hours, resolution within 8 hours.

P3: response within 4 business hours, resolution within 2 business days.

## Escalation Chain

1. Service desk (first point of contact).

2. Desk lead for SLA breaches.

3. IT service manager and the business owner for P1 events.

## Reporting

SLA performance publishes on the monthly service dashboard.

## Policy code

IT-SLA-LAPTOP-2026-01 | Owner: IT Service Management.

# Internal Job Mobility

## Eligibility
Employees may apply for internal openings after 18 months in the current role. Cross-entity
moves are also subject to approval from the current business head.

## Process
1. Apply through the internal career portal.
2. The hiring manager evaluates the profile without prior approval from the current manager.
3. Current manager approval is sought only at the offer stage.

## Notice to Current Team
Internal moves carry a handover period of 30 to 45 days, based on role criticality, agreed
between the two managers.

## Compensation on Move
Lateral moves do not change grade. Promotional moves follow the promotion guidelines.

[S1] What is the leave policy at Axis Bank?
Q: What is the leave policy at Axis Bank?
A: Employees are entitled to 24 privileged leaves, 8 casual leaves and 12 sick leaves per calendar year. Privileged leaves must be planned at least 7 working days in advance and can be availed up to 3 times a year. Unused privileged leaves are carried forward up to a cap of 60 days.

[S2] Leave Policy 2026
# Leave Policy — 2026

## Applicability
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Axis Bank across corporate offices,
branches and contact centres. Contractual and third-party staff are governed by the
terms of their engagement contracts.

## Types of Leave

### Privileged Leave (PL)
- 24 working days per calendar year, credited quarterly (6 per quarter).
- Can be availed up to 3 times a year.
- Minimum block of 3 continuous days per instance.
- Requests must be raised on the HR self-service portal at least 7 working days in
  advance for domestic travel and 14 working days for international travel.
- Unused PL carries forward up to a cap of 60 days.

### Casual Leave (CL)
- 8 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Cannot be carried forward.
- Maximum block of 2 continuous days.
- Requires reporting manager approval; can be applied on the same day for genuine
  emergencies.

### Sick Leave (SL)
- 12 working days per calendar year, credited on 1st January.
- Medical certificate mandatory for any block of 3 or more continuous days.
- Cannot be carried forward.

### Maternity Leave
- 26 weeks of paid leave for the first two children.
- 12 weeks of paid leave from the third child onwards.
- Adoption leave of 12 weeks for children below 3 months of age.
- Requests must be raised at least 8 weeks before the expected date, with the
  medical certificate attached.

### Paternity Leave
- 10 working days of paid leave available within 90 days of the child's birth.
- Can be split into 2 blocks.

### Bereavement Leave
- 5 working days for immediate family (spouse, child, parent, sibling).
- 2 working days for extended family.

## Compensatory Off
- Employees working on declared holidays are eligible for compensatory off within 45 days.
- Compensatory off cannot be encashed.

## Encashment
- On separation, up to 60 days of PL balance is encashed at basic + DA.
- CL and SL are not encashable.

## Escalation
For any dispute regarding leave balance, raise a ticket on HResponse under
`HR > Leave Balance`. First-level SLA is 2 business days.

# Outsourcing Governance Guidelines

## Regulatory Basis
Outsourcing of material activities follows RBI guidelines on outsourcing of
financial services.

## Materiality Assessment
Activities are assessed for materiality based on impact on customers, data
confidentiality, regulatory reporting and business continuity.

## Board Oversight
Material outsourcing arrangements are approved by the board or its committee.
The outsourcing policy is reviewed annually.

## Service Provider Management
SLAs, audit rights, sub-contracting restrictions and exit clauses are mandated
in contracts.

## Records
The register of outsourcing arrangements is maintained centrally and available
to auditors and supervisors.

Policy code: LAW-OS-2026-01 | Owner: Compliance.

[S5] Which documents are needed for enhanced due diligence?
Q: Which documents are needed for enhanced due diligence?
A: Officially Valid Documents plus PAN or Form 60; non-individuals need constitutional documents.

# Outsourcing Governance Guidelines

## Regulatory Basis
Outsourcing of material activities follows RBI guidelines on outsourcing of
financial services.

## Materiality Assessment
Activities are assessed for materiality based on impact on customers, data
confidentiality, regulatory reporting and business continuity.

## Board Oversight
Material outsourcing arrangements are approved by the board or its committee.
The outsourcing policy is reviewed annually.

## Service Provider Management
SLAs, audit rights, sub-contracting restrictions and exit clauses are mandated
in contracts.

## Records
The register of outsourcing arrangements is maintained centrally and available
to auditors and supervisors.

Policy code: LAW-OS-2026-01 | Owner: Compliance.

# Change Freeze Note: New Year Window

## Freeze Window

The New Year Window freeze covers 31 December to 2 January.

## Applicability

All production changes need a freeze exception during the window.

Customer-facing systems are fully frozen; internal systems follow the calendar.

## Exceptions

Exceptions route as emergency changes with CIO approval.

Incident remediation is always permitted.

# Change Freeze Calendar

## Freeze Periods
- Financial year-end: last 5 business days of March.
- Half-year close: last 3 business days of September.
- RBI-mandated reporting windows.

# Eligibility & Documents: Credit Cards

## Eligibility

Eligibility follows the product policy: age, income, credit and relationship criteria.

Co-applicants and guarantors are governed by the product rules.

## Documents

KYC: Officially Valid Documents plus PAN or Form 60.

Income proof as per the product checklist.

Purpose or security documents for secured products.

## Verification

Verify documents at origination and re-verify per policy.

## Rejections

Rejections state the policy clause; refer to the credit desk for appeals.

## Policy code

FA-ELIG-CARDS-2026-01 | Owner: Products & Advisory.

[S4] Credit Card Variants
# Credit Card Variants

## Portfolio
- Entry cards for first-time users.
- Rewards cards with accelerated points on categories.
- Cashback cards for everyday spends.
- Travel and premium cards with lounge and milestone benefits.

## Eligibility
Age 21-65 (primary), income thresholds by variant, good bureau score and
internal policy checks.

## Features
Interest-free period up to the prescribed days, EMI conversion, balance
transfer (subject to policy) and fraud cover.

## Billing
Billing cycle and due dates are defined at issuance. Minimum amount due and
late-payment implications are in the cardholder agreement.

Advisory note: always disclose fees, charges and interest to customers
before recommending a card.

[S5] Where can a customer check card eligibility?
Q: Where can a customer check card eligibility?
A: The mobile app, statements and the cardholder agreement.

- 15-year tenure, extendable in 5-year blocks.

[S3] Pf Gratuity
# Provident Fund (PF) & Gratuity — Quick Reference

## Provident Fund
- Contribution: **12% of basic + DA** by the employee, matched by the employer.
- Employer contribution split: 8.33% to EPS (Employee Pension Scheme, capped
  on ₹15,000 basic) + balance to EPF.
- Interest is credited annually as declared by the EPFO.
- Withdrawals: partial withdrawals allowed for defined reasons (marriage,
  higher education, home purchase, medical emergency) subject to service
  tenure thresholds.
- Universal Account Number (UAN) is issued at joining and is portable across
  employers.

## Gratuity
- Payable on separation after continuous service of at least **5 years**
  (waived for death / permanent disability).
- Formula: `(Last drawn basic + DA) × 15 / 26 × completed years of service`.
- Statutory cap: ₹20,00,000 (tax-exempt limit).
- Paid within 30 days of the last working day; delays attract simple interest
  at the notified rate.

## Nomination
Employees must nominate their PF and gratuity beneficiaries within 30 days of
joining and update nominations after any life event (marriage, birth of
child, divorce).

## Related Forms
Download from `Download > HR > Statutory Forms`:
- `PF-NOM-1` — PF nomination
- `GRAT-NOM-2` — Gratuity nomination
- `PF-WD-31` — Partial PF withdrawal

## Policy Code
`HR-STAT-2026-03` · Owner: Employee Services team.

# Aha Redemption Catalogue

## Categories
- E-vouchers: retail, food, travel and wellness brands.
- Merchandise: electronics, home and lifestyle.
- Experiences: curated events and activities.
- Giving: donate points to approved causes.

## Value
Redemption values are published in points per item. Values refresh quarterly
with catalogue updates.

## Delivery
E-vouchers deliver instantly. Physical items ship within 7-10 business days
to the registered address.

## Expiry
Points expire 24 months after award. Expiring points are flagged on the
dashboard 60 days in advance.

# Teams & SharePoint Guidelines

## Team Creation
Teams are created per project or department with an owner and a defined
lifespan. Naming follows the agreed convention.

## Permissions
Use groups, not individuals, for access. External guests require sponsor
approval and expiry dates.

## Data Classification
Sites are labelled by data classification. Confidential sites enforce
stricter sharing rules.

## Lifecycle
Inactive sites are archived after 180 days of inactivity. Owners are
notified 30 days in advance.

Policy code: IT-Collab-2026-01 | Owner: Collaboration Services.

# Emergency Change Process

## Definition
Emergency changes address production incidents requiring immediate
remediation, where waiting for CAB would extend impact.

## Initiation
The incident commander opens an emergency CR with the incident ID linked.

## Approval
Emergency approval requires two approvers from the on-call list, one of
whom is a manager or above.

## Retrospective
Every emergency change undergoes post-implementation review within 5
working days. Unplanned work is reported to CAB.

## Controls
Abuse of the emergency route (pre-planned work logged as emergency) is a
compliance breach.

consent, breach notification and data principal rights.

The owning team translates the framework into internal policies and procedures.

Staff must follow the internal procedure even where it is stricter than the statute.

Keep the latest internal circular handy for day-to-day decisions.

Escalate interpretation questions to the compliance desk.

Preserve records for the retention period; never alter audit trails.

The compliance intranet summarises applicability; the full text is on the regulator's site.

Q: What does DPDP require for consent?

USER QUESTION:
How do I raise a data breach report?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] How do I raise a data breach report?
Q: How do I raise a data breach report?
A: Any suspected personal-data breach must be reported to the Data Protection Officer within 24 hours by raising a Priority-Zero incident on Unidesk. The DPO notifies the Data Protection Board within 72 hours for notifiable breaches.

[S2] Data Breach Response
# Data Breach Response Protocol

## Detection
Security events are detected through monitoring tools, staff reports and vendor
alerts. Every suspected personal-data breach is logged as a Priority-Zero incident.

## Containment
Containment includes isolating affected systems, revoking compromised credentials
and preserving forensic evidence without modification.

## Notification
Notifiable breaches are reported to the Data Protection Board within 72 hours
under the DPDP framework, and affected data principals are informed promptly.

## Investigation
Root-cause analysis is completed within 15 working days. Corrective actions are
tracked to closure with the Chief Information Security Officer.

## Review
The breach register is reviewed quarterly by the Risk Management Committee.

Policy code: LAW-BR-2026-01 | Owner: Data Protection Office.

[S3] What happens if we miss breach notification?
Q: What happens if we miss breach notification?
A: Regulatory penalty exposure and escalation to the Data Protection Office.

## Situation

## Key Considerations

Vendor-side breaches activate the incident playbook and contractual notification timelines.

## Immediate Steps

1. Preserve all evidence in its current state.

2. Inform the owning team and the compliance or legal desk.

3. Do not communicate externally without approval.

## Escalation

Escalate to the relevant officer within the same business day.

## Policy code

Q: How does salary credit work?
A: For salary credit: salary credits on the 25th of every month, or the next working day if the 25th is a holiday.

A: Check the HR portal under Pay & Benefits; supporting details appear on the payslip.

Q: How does payslip access work?
A: For payslip access: payslips publish on the HR portal two days before salary credit.

sources.title: Who should I contact about salary credit?
sources.snippet:
Q: Who should I contact about salary credit?
A: Use the payroll helpdesk in the HR portal; the SLA is 2 business days.

sources.title: What should I do if salary credit looks incorrect?
sources.snippet:
Q: What should I do if salary credit looks incorrect?
A: Raise a discrepancy ticket with the payslip copy; corrections apply in the next cycle.

# Phishing & Suspicious Email Reporting

## Identify
Watch for urgent language, unexpected attachments, mismatched sender domains
and links to unfamiliar sites.

## Report
Use the report-phishing button in the mail client or forward to the security
mailbox. Do not reply or open attachments.

## After Reporting
Delete the mail after reporting. If you clicked a link or opened an
attachment, call the security operations centre immediately.

## Simulations
The bank runs periodic phishing simulations. Reporting simulated messages
correctly is tracked for awareness metrics.

Policy code: IT-PHISH-2026-01 | Owner: Security Operations.

Q: How quickly must I report a phishing email?
A: Report immediately; some reports carry a 24-hour policy or statutory window.

sources.title: What is CDD documentation?
sources.snippet:
Q: What is CDD documentation?
A: For KYC, CDD documentation means: collect Officially Valid Documents, PAN or Form 60, and a live photograph as per the Master Direction.

sources.title: How often does CDD documentation apply?
sources.snippet:
Q: How often does CDD documentation apply?
A: As per the customer risk category; the Master Direction sets minimum frequencies.

sources.title: Which documents are needed for CDD documentation?
sources.snippet:
Q: Which documents are needed for CDD documentation?
A: Officially Valid Documents plus PAN or Form 60; non-individuals need constitutional documents.

sources.title: Where do I record CDD documentation?
sources.snippet:
Q: Where do I record CDD documentation?
A: Record in the KYC system with the checklist; documents attach to the customer record.

sources.title: What happens if CDD documentation is incomplete?
sources.snippet:
Q: What happens if CDD documentation is incomplete?
A: Account opening or updation is deferred until documents are complete.

sources.snippet:
# Customer Grievance Redressal Policy

## Channels
Customers may raise complaints through branches, contact centre, internet
banking, mobile app or the dedicated grievance portal.

## Acknowledgement
Every complaint receives an acknowledgement with a reference number immediately

# Customer Grievance Redressal Policy

## Channels
Customers may raise complaints through branches, contact centre, internet
banking, mobile app or the dedicated grievance portal.

## Acknowledgement
Every complaint receives an acknowledgement with a reference number immediately
on registration.

## Turnaround
Standard complaints: 7 working days. Complex complaints involving investigation:
30 days. Exceptions are communicated with reasons.

## Escalation
Unresolved complaints escalate to the nodal officer, then the Principal Nodal
Officer, then the Ombudsman.

## Root-Cause Review
Repeated complaint categories are reviewed monthly to fix underlying causes.

Policy code: LAW-CGR-2026-01 | Owner: Customer Advocacy.

USER QUESTION:
What are the working hours for branch staff?

RETRIEVED CONTEXT (cite as [S1], [S2], ...):
[S1] What are the working hours for branch staff?
Q: What are the working hours for branch staff?
A: Branch operating window is 09:30 to 17:30 on weekdays and 09:30 to 13:30 on second and fourth Saturdays. Front-office staff are expected to be on floor 15 minutes before opening.

[S2] Flexible Work Hours
# Flexible Work Hours Framework

## Core Hours
The core collaboration window is 10:00 to 17:30 IST. Employees may flex their start time
between 08:00 and 10:30 IST, provided the full workday is completed.

## Staggering
Teams with heavy branch or market dependency may define staggered shifts. Shift definitions
are approved by the business head and published in the team charter.

## Overtime
Overtime is exceptional and must be pre-approved. Approved overtime is compensated as
compensatory off within 45 days, not as cash, except for grades where overtime pay is statutory.

## Flexibility Requests
Flexible start-time requests need reporting-manager approval and must not impact service
windows, market hours or client commitments.

Policy code: HR-FLEX-2026-01 | Owner: HR Business Policy team.

[S3] What are the flexible working hours rules?
Q: What are the flexible working hours rules?
A: For flexible working hours, the arrival window is 08:00 to 10:30 IST with a 9-hour workday and core hours of 10:30 to 16:30.

[S4] Remote Work Policy
# Remote Work Policy

## Eligibility
Remote work is available to employees in roles that do not require physical presence.
Eligibility is role-based, not request-based. Customer-facing and vault roles are excluded.

## Hybrid Pattern
Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days per week. Remote days must be planned
with the reporting manager at least one working day in advance and recorded in the attendance tool.

## Equipment and Connectivity
The bank provides a laptop and VPN. Employees must maintain a stable internet connection
(minimum 10 Mbps) and a quiet, secure workspace. Home Wi-Fi must use WPA2 or stronger.

## Information Security on Remote Days
- Client and internal documents must never be printed at home.
- Screen-locking is mandatory when stepping away.
- Video calls involving customer data must use the approved collaboration platform only.

## Performance Expectations
Remote work does not change performance standards. Teams define core collaboration hours
(between 10:00 and 17:30 IST) when availability is expected.

Policy code: HR-RWFH-2026-01 | Owner: HR Business Policy team.

[S5] Gen Leave Planning Bops
# Branch Operations Leave Planning Guide 2026

## Purpose

This guide helps Branch Operations teams plan leave without compromising coverage during peak periods such as month-end and regulatory reporting peaks.

## Planning Rules

Privileged leave needs at least 7 working days of notice and manager approval.

At least 70 percent of the team must be available during declared peak windows.

Backfill plans must be agreed before overlapping leave is approved.

## Seasonal Guidance

Anticipate demand around month-end and regulatory reporting peaks and open early leave planning.

Rotate preferred holiday weeks across the team from year to year.

## Manager Duties

Publish the unit leave calendar quarterly.

Review pending balances and prompt planned usage.

Escalate conflicts to the HR business partner.

## Policy code

HR-LVG-BOPS-2026-01 | Owner: HR Operations.

The bank provides a laptop and VPN. Employees must maintain a stable internet connection
(minimum 10 Mbps) and a quiet, secure workspace. Home Wi-Fi must use WPA2 or stronger.

## Information Security on Remote Days
- Client and internal documents must never be printed at home.
- Screen-locking is mandatory when stepping away.
- Video calls involving customer data must use the approved collaboration platform only.

## Performance Expectations
Remote work does not change performance standards. Teams define core collaboration hours
(between 10:00 and 17:30 IST) when availability is expected.

# Branch Operations Leave Planning Guide 2026

## Purpose

This guide helps Branch Operations teams plan leave without compromising coverage during peak periods such as month-end and regulatory reporting peaks.

## Planning Rules

Privileged leave needs at least 7 working days of notice and manager approval.

At least 70 percent of the team must be available during declared peak windows.

Backfill plans must be agreed before overlapping leave is approved.

## Seasonal Guidance

Anticipate demand around month-end and regulatory reporting peaks and open early leave planning.

Rotate preferred holiday weeks across the team from year to year.

## Manager Duties

Publish the unit leave calendar quarterly.

Review pending balances and prompt planned usage.

Escalate conflicts to the HR business partner.

# Flexible Work Hours Framework

## Core Hours
The core collaboration window is 10:00 to 17:30 IST. Employees may flex their start time
between 08:00 and 10:30 IST, provided the full workday is completed.

## Staggering
Teams with heavy branch or market dependency may define staggered shifts. Shift definitions
are approved by the business head and published in the team charter.

## Overtime
Overtime is exceptional and must be pre-approved. Approved overtime is compensated as
compensatory off within 45 days, not as cash, except for grades where overtime pay is statutory.

## Flexibility Requests
Flexible start-time requests need reporting-manager approval and must not impact service
windows, market hours or client commitments.

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

_Source: Adapted from Wikipedia's "Retrieval-augmented generation" article,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0._

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

_Source: Adapted from Wikipedia's "Retrieval-augmented generation" article,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0._

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

_Source: Adapted from Wikipedia's "Retrieval-augmented generation" article,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0._

[S3] Rag Background
# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

_Source: Adapted from Wikipedia's "Retrieval-augmented generation" article,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0._

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

_Source: Adapted from Wikipedia's "Retrieval-augmented generation" article,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0._

# Background: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a technique that enables large
language models (LLMs) to retrieve and incorporate new information from
external data sources at inference time, instead of relying solely on their
pre-training data.

At a high level, a RAG system operates in three stages:

1. **Indexing.** External data (documents, tables, knowledge graphs) is
   converted into vector embeddings and stored in a vector database.
2. **Retrieval.** For a given user query, a retriever selects the most
   relevant documents from the vector store. Reranking, hybrid search
   (sparse + dense) and late-interaction models such as ColBERT are common
   accuracy improvements.
3. **Generation.** The retrieved passages are supplied to the LLM through
   prompt engineering ("prompt stuffing"), so the model prioritises the
   retrieved context over its parametric memory when producing an answer.

RAG improves factuality, allows citing sources for verification, and removes
the need to retrain the base model when knowledge changes. It does not
eliminate hallucinations: models can still misinterpret retrieved context,
combine outdated and updated information, or generate false claims when
retrieval quality is poor ("RAG poisoning"). Robust RAG systems therefore
depend heavily on chunking strategy, retriever quality, reranking, and
downstream guardrails.

_Source: Adapted from Wikipedia's "Retrieval-augmented generation" article,
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0._

[S1] What is record retention?
Q: What is record retention?
A: record retention: maintain KYC and transaction records for the prescribed period after account closure.

[S2] Document Retention Policy
# Document Retention Policy

## Principles
Records are retained for legal, regulatory, tax and business needs and disposed
of thereafter through an approved process.

## Retention Classes
- KYC and transaction records: as per PMLA requirements.
- Tax records: as per Income-Tax Act.
- Employment records: as per labour statutes.
- Contracts: for the contract term plus limitation periods.

## Litigation Hold
When litigation or investigation is anticipated, relevant records are preserved
notwithstanding retention expiry.

## Disposal
Disposal uses shredding or certified digital erasure with an audit trail.

Policy code: LAW-RET-2026-01 | Owner: Records Management.

[S3] Rbi Kyc Master Direction
# KYC Master Direction Essentials

## Regulatory Basis
Customer onboarding follows the RBI Master Direction on Know Your Customer,
2016 (as amended).

## CDD at Onboarding
- Identify and verify the customer using Officially Valid Documents.
- Verify beneficial owners for non-individual customers.
- Assign a risk category: low, medium or high.

## Periodic Updation
High-risk customers: KYC refreshed every 2 years. Medium: every 8 years.
Low: every 10 years. Re-KYC is event-driven for significant changes.

## Enhanced Due Diligence
EDD applies to PEPs, high-risk geographies and high-value or complex
transactions, including source-of-funds checks.

## Record Retention
KYC records are maintained for the prescribed period after account closure as
per PMLA requirements.

Policy code: LAW-KYC-RBI-2026-01 | Owner: Compliance.

[S4] What happens if re-KYC timelines is incomplete?
Q: What happens if re-KYC timelines is incomplete?
A: Account opening or updation is deferred until documents are complete.

[S5] Where do I record re-KYC timelines?
Q: Where do I record re-KYC timelines?
A: Record in the KYC system with the checklist; documents attach to the customer record.
